क्योंकि मसीह ने मुझे बपतिस्मा देने के लिए नहीं भेजा, परन्तु सुसमाचार सुनाने के लिए: न वाक्-कला की बुद्धिमत्ता से, कि मसीह की क्रूस की शक्ति निरर्थक न हो जाए। क्योंकि क्रूस का उपदेश उन लोगों के लिए मूर्खता है जो नाश होते हैं; परन्तु हम जो उद्धार पाते हैं, उसके लिए वह परमेश्वर की शक्ति है। …परमेश्वर को प्रसन्न हुआ कि उपदेश की मूर्खता द्वारा उन लोगों को बचाए जो विश्वास करते हैं –1 कुरिन्थियों 1:17-21।

आधुनिक ईसाई जगत ने उन अनेक निम्नस्तरीय माध्यमों को भली-भाती स्वीकार कर लिया है जिनके द्वारा परमेश्वर ने राज्य की स्थापना करवाई थी। कुँवारी जन्म, सादा पालना, और लंगोटियाँ अब ऐसे प्रमुख प्रतीक बन गए हैं जिनके बिना हम मुश्किल से चल सकते हैं। यहाँ तक कि सादा गधे को भी गुड फ्राइडे पर सम्मान दिया जाता है, और पुराना, कठोर क्रूस एक आध्यात्मिक प्रतीक बन गया है जिसे अक्सर गर्दन की चैन और गोपनीय पुलपिट/वेदियों की अलंकृत नक्काशी पर दिखाया जाता है। जबकि मनुष्य सुसमाचार के पारंपरिक चिन्हों से मोहित रहते हैं, एक विडंबनापूर्ण मार्ग जो परमेश्वर ने चुना था आजकल बढ़ते हुए तिरस्कृत हो रहा है।

सदियों तक, सुसमाचार को मूर्ख और अनपढ़ पुरुषों (उनके अभिजात और बौद्धिक समकक्षों के अनुसार) द्वारा प्रचारित किया गया। सादगी में कही गई बाइबिलीय सच्चाई स्वयं ही पर्याप्त थी कि परमेश्वर की पवित्र आत्मा उसे पापी के परिवर्तन के लिये उपयोग करे। आजकल उपदेश की कोई कसर नहीं है, पर ऐसा प्रतीत होता है कि अधिकांश उपदेश उस मूल रूप से भिन्न किस्म के हैं जिसका मसीह ने उदाहरण देकर प्रदर्शन किया था। यदि कोई सटीक दार्शनिक भाषा में वाग्भाषण कर सकता था तो वह प्रेरित पौलूस ही होते। तथापि उन्होंने इस प्रकार से सुसमाचार प्रचार करना अस्वीकार कर दिया, …कि मसीह की क्रूस की शक्ति निरर्थक न हो जाए –1 कुरिन्थियों 1:17। उन्होंने सावधानी से उपदेश किया, ताकि सफलता को कला की शक्ति का श्रेय न दिया जाए, बल्कि सत्य की शक्ति का ही मान रखा जाए।

पौलुस को गमलीएल के चरणों में यहूदी शिक्षा में प्रशिक्षित किया गया था और वे हिब्रू तथा यूनानी दोनों भाषाओं में प्रवीण थे, पर मसीह की क्रूस का उपदेश देते समय उन्होंने अपनी शिक्षा को अलग रख दिया। उन्होंने सुसमाचार के शब्द ऐसी भांति कहे जो मानवीय शक्ति से रहित थे ताकि मसीह को मिलने वाला सम्मान उनकी निजी क्षमता द्वारा ढक न दिया जाए। क्योंकि उनके पत्र कहें तो वे भारी और शक्तिशाली हैं; परन्तु उनकी शरीरगत उपस्थिति दुर्बल है, और उनका भाषण तुच्छ है –2 कुरिन्थियों 10:10। यहीं आधुनिक चर्च ने मसीह और प्रेरितों द्वारा चुने गए सरल माध्यमों को ठुकरा दिया है और हमारे युग के अनुकूल एक अधिक स्वीकार्य मार्ग अपना लिया है। आधुनिक दक्षता अंतिम लक्ष्य तक जाने के लिए अधिक प्रत्यक्ष मार्ग मांगती है, और यदि बाइबिल उस पर निषेध नहीं करती, तो हमें लगता है कि इसे अपनाना हमारा अधिकार है।

हालाँकि ईवांजेलिकल फिल्में, संगीत समारोह, और अनेक अन्य संदिग्ध मंत्रालय मंचों का उल्लेख किया जा सकता है, मैं मुख्य रूप से उस आधुनिक निमंत्रण प्रणाली के विषय में बोलना चाहूँगा जिसे "ऑल्टर कॉल" कहा जाता है। हालाँकि यह सामान्यतः पिछले दो सदियों की "पुरानी शैली की बैठकों" से जुड़ी मानी जाती है, यह वास्तव में आधुनिक है क्योंकि लगभग उन्नीस सदी तक किसी ने इस प्रथा के बारे में नहीं सुना था। जॉर्ज व्हाइटफ़ील्ड, जोनाथन एडवर्ड्स, और यहाँ तक कि जॉन वेस्ले जैसे उपदेशकों ने इस रिवाज़ का नाम तक नहीं सुना था। चार्ल्स स्पर्जन (जिन्हें "उपदेशकों का राजकुमार" कहा जाता है) ने भी इसकी तीव्र आलोचना की और इसे अपनाने से मना किया।*

इस प्रकार हम देखते हैं कि यह प्रथा प्रेरितीय चर्च में उत्पन्न नहीं हुई। यह यीशु के मंत्रालय में, उनके प्रेरितों में, या प्रेरितोत्तर काल के चर्च में नहीं मिलती। हम देखते हैं कि यीशु और प्रेरित लोग पुरुषों और महिलाओं को मसीह के पास आने और उद्धार पाने के लिए बुलाते थे, पर कभी भी इस विशेष पद्धति से नहीं। तो फिर यह प्रथा आज अधिकांश ईवांजेलिकल और कई एनाबैपटिस्ट चर्चों में इतनी आवश्यक उपकरण कैसे बन गई? उत्तर—व्यावहारिक परिणामों में निहित है। प्रवचन के तुरंत पश्चात्, सभागृह भजन गाता है जिसके दौरान प्रचारक पुरुषों और महिलाओं को सभागृह के सामने ("ऑल्टर") चलने के लिए बुलाता है ताकि वे मसीह के लिए सार्वजनिक निर्णय ले सकें। उद्धार उन सभी को दिया जाता है जो सामने आकर इसे ग्रहण करते हैं। जो लोग आते हैं उन्हें अक्सर एक परामर्शदाता का व्यक्तिगत ध्यान मिलता है जो उनके साथ प्रार्थना करता है और उन्हें स्वीकारोक्ति के माध्यम से मार्गदर्शन देता है।

यह अभ्यास निर्णयों को प्रोत्साहित करने और त्वरित परिणाम प्राप्त करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया था। और यह काम भी करता था। थोड़े-बहुत परिवर्तनों के साथ यह नई विधि चार्ल्स फ़िन्नी के माध्यम से बढ़ती लोकप्रियता के साथ फैली, बाद में ड्वाइट एल. मूडी ने भी इसका उपयोग किया, और अंततः यह उन्नीसवीं और बीसवीं सदी के लगभग सभी ईवांजेलिकल परम्पराओं में प्रवेश कर गई। पीटर कार्ट्राइट, सैम जोन्स, आर. ए. टॉरी, बिली संडे, बॉब जोन्स, गिप्सी स्मिथ, जॉन आर. राइस, बिली ग्राहम, और जॉर्ज ब्रंक—सभी ने इस पद्धति को प्रभावशाली सफलता के साथ अपनाया। इस प्रकार निमंत्रण प्रणाली स्वीकार्य सामान्य अभ्यास बन गई और जो इसे प्रश्न करते हैं उन्हें अक्सर आध्यात्मिक रूप से विचित्र माना जाता है।

यदि शास्त्र इसे मना नहीं करता तो हमें प्रथा पर प्रश्न क्यों उठाना चाहिए? उत्तर उस प्रणाली की उपयुक्तता के प्रश्न में निहित है। पहले यह स्वीकार करें कि शास्त्र उद्धार के लिए निमंत्रणों से परिपूर्ण है। जैसे प्रस्ताव, मेरे पास आओ, …और मैं तुम्हें विश्राम दूँगा –मत्ती 11:28, और …यदि कोई प्यासा हो, उसे मुझ पर आकर पिए—यूहन्ना 7:37, उन लोगों के लिए जीवन के अद्भुत प्रस्ताव हैं जो मसीह पर भरोसा करेंगे। प्रेरितों ने भी बिना संकोच के मसीह को उद्धारकर्ता के रूप में सबको प्रस्तुत किया जो उनका संदेश सुनते थे।

वे भेदभाव किए बिना प्रचार करते थे, इसलिये तुम पश्चात्ताप करो और परिवर्तित हो जाओ कि तुम्हारे पाप मिटा दिए जाएँ… –प्रेरितों के काम 3:19, और …हम मसीह की ओर से तुमसे निवेदन करते हैं कि परमेश्वर से सुलहा कर लो –2 कुरिन्थियों 5:20। और उन्होंने साक्ष्य दिया …यहूदियों को, और साथ ही यूनानियों को, परमेश्वर के प्रति पश्चात्ताप और हमारे प्रभु यीशु मसीह में विश्वास –प्रेरितों के काम 20:21। इन सब के साथ, हर ईसाई को न केवल सहमति बल्कि आनन्द होना चाहिए।

अन्ततः, …बाध्य करो कि वे अंदर आ जाएँ, कि मेरा घर भरा हो जाए –लूका 14:23, एक और शास्त्रीय पद है जिसे ऑल्टर कॉल पद्धति के समर्थन में उद्धृत किया जा सकता है। फिर भी, यह पद ऑल्टर कॉल की शुद्धता को स्वतः पुष्ट नहीं करता। जब हम प्रथा की जड़ों की जाँच करते हैं, तो कुछ कमियाँ स्पष्ट रूप से दिखलाई देती हैं:

…बाइबिल के परे

यह उन अनगिनत लोगों पर कोई अवमानना नहीं है जिन्होंने ऐसी किसी सभा में उद्धार पाया। स्वर्गदूत हर पापी के पश्चात्ताप पर आनन्दित होते हैं चाहे वह किसी भी मार्ग से पहुँचा हो। हम केवल उपदेश की मूर्खता की सादगी का पालन करना चाहते हैं—वह आत्मा द्वारा विश्वास करने वालों को बचा सकती है। ऑल्टर कॉल प्रवचन के एक विशिष्ट अतिरिक्त के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है ताकि जो उपदेश की मूर्खता स्वयं से पूरा न कर पाए वह पूरा किया जा सके।

ऑल्टर कॉल 1830 के दशक में चार्ल्स जी. फिन्नी के प्रचार के साथ लोकप्रिय हुआ, जिन्होंने लिखा, “एक पुनरुत्थान कोई चमत्कार नहीं है, और किसी अर्थ में चमत्कार पर निर्भर नहीं है। यह संविधानिक साधनों के सही उपयोग का शुद्ध दार्शनिक परिणाम है।” ** हम यह आरोप नहीं लगा सकते कि जो सब लोग ऑल्टर कॉल का अभ्यास करते हैं वे यही मानते हैं, पर यह स्पष्ट है कि जिसने इसे लोकप्रिय बनाया उसने इसे ईश्वरीय सहभागीता से अधिक एक गणितीय समीकरण के समान माना।

जब सत्य एक नेक और ईमानदार हृदय की मिट्टी पर गिरता है, तो बीज वास्तव में जड़ पकड़ता है और फल देता है। इस सत्य के बीज को किसी कृत्रिम आवरण की आवश्यकता नहीं है। यह अपनी ही ज्योति में महानता के साथ चमकता है और अपनी दैवीय अधिकारिता द्वारा संसार में विजय पाता है। यह आत्मा का प्रदर्शन है, मानवीय आविष्कार या हस्तक्षेप की आवश्यकता के बिना। क्रूसित मसीह का सरल उपदेश सारी वाग्मिता, दार्शनिकता और भावनात्मक विधियों से अधिक शक्तिशाली है।

…भावनात्मक प्रेरणा

ऑल्टर कॉल में चाहने वाले से अपेक्षा की जाती है कि वह अपनी सीट छोड़कर सामने आए और क्षमा प्राप्त करने के लिए बढ़े। ये निमंत्रण अक्सर इतने हृदयस्पर्शी वृत्तांतों, दुखद कहानियों, या ऐसे गवाहियों से पूर्वी होते हैं जो भावनाओं को भय, अपराधबोध, या पश्चाताप की ओर उभारते हैं। सभा द्वारा गाये गए कोमल भजन के साथ भावनाएँ आगे बढ़ने के लिए तैयार हो जाती हैं। जो लोग अपनी सीट पर बैठकर पश्चात्ताप करते हैं पर आगे नहीं आते, उन्हें अक्सर “एक अवसर गंवाने वाला” माना जाता है।

और ये वे भी हैं जो पथरीली जमीन पर बोए जाते हैं; जो जब उन्होंने वचन सुना तो तुरंत खुशी से स्वीकार कर लेते हैं; और उनमें अपने आप में जड़ नहीं है, और इसलिए केवल कुछ समय के लिये टिकते हैं: बाद में, जब वचन के कारण दुख या उत्पीड़न उत्पन्न होता है, तो वे तुर्हन्त ठेस खाते हैं –मरकुस 4:16-17। हम यह निष्कर्ष निकालने से इंकार करते हैं कि जो लोग इस प्रकार की सेवा के अंतर्गत परिवर्तित हुए वे सभी पथरीली जमीन सुनने वाले हैं। तथापि, जिन लोगों ने इतनी तीव्र भावनात्मक स्थिति में इसे ग्रहण किया उनका बड़ा बहुमत अक्सर कम ईमानदार परिवर्तन का प्रदर्शन करता है।

एक बार मेरे दुकान में एक उत्साही ग्राहक आया जिसने कहा कि उनके चर्च ने एक राष्ट्रीय ईवांजेलिकल मंत्रालय का समर्थन किया था जो सार्वजनिक हाई स्कूल में प्रचार कर रहा था। “मसीह के लिए 400 से अधिक निर्णय हुए!” जबकि हम सब स्वर्गदूतों के साथ आनन्दित होना चाहेंगे, यह प्रश्न उठता है कि उनमें से कितने एक वर्ष बाद भी चर्च में बने रहे। हालांकि सच्ची प्रतिबद्धता की कमी केवल ऑल्टर कॉल के उपयोग पर नहीं ठहराई जा सकती, पर हम निश्चित हो सकते हैं कि जो बीज इतना शीघ्र उभरता है वह भावनात्मक निमंत्रण के सन्दर्भ में अपनी प्रकृति दिखाएगा। जिनका कोई मूल नहीं है वे जल्दबाजी में उत्तर देने के बजाय बेहतर होंगे।

भावनात्मक माध्यमों द्वारा उत्पन्न परिवर्तन प्रायः संदिग्ध और अस्थायी होते हैं। पवित्र आत्मा की प्रेरणाओं को मानवीय शक्ति, बुद्धि, या प्रयासों की आवश्यकता नहीं होती। पुनरुत्थान के तरीके जैसे चिल्लाना, खुले आँसू बहाना, भावनाएँ उकसाने वाला संगीत, और भावुक कहानियाँ कहना उपदेश की मानवनिर्मित कला है। यह कई अन्य सार्वजनिक मंचों में भी पाया जाता है जो श्रोता से किसी पूर्वनिर्धारित प्रतिक्रिया उत्पन्न करने के लिये डिजाइन किए गए हैं। इन आयामों में से प्रत्येक मानवीय व्यवहार के लिये स्वाभाविक है और कभी-कभी उपदेश में स्वीकार्य और अस्वीकार्य के बीच महीन रेखा रहती है। बड़ी सावधानी बरती जानी चाहिए कि हम भावनात्मक चरमोत्कर्ष न बनाएं जिससे संदेश छिप जाये और शक्ति मनुष्यों की दिखाई दे न कि मसीह की।

…मातृ / पितृ तथा स्थानीय चर्च अधिकार का अतिक्रमण

ऐसी परिस्थितियों में अक्सर बच्चे लक्षित होते हैं। वे किसी बाल्य कृत्य के कारण अपराधबोध महसूस कर सकते हैं, पर एक तीव्र संदेश और भावनात्मक आग्रह बहुत अशांत करने वाला हो सकता है। ऐसे समय माता-पिता को अपने बच्चे के हृदय से बात करनी चाहिए और आध्यात्मिक रूप से जुड़ना चाहिए। इसके बजाय अक्सर बच्चे को सामने बुलाया जाता है और एक चर्च परामर्शदाता को दिया जाता है ताकि वह अपनी स्वीकारोक्ति कर सके।

मैं एक महिला को जानता हूँ जिसका पिता एक भ्रमणशील ईवांजेलिकल उपदेशक था। वह कहती है कि उसने "सैकड़ों बार" ऑल्टर कॉल का उत्तर दिया। एक सहज और ईमानदार मूल्यांकन यह प्रकट करेगा कि जबकि ऑल्टर कॉल कई सच्चे परिवर्तनों की शुरुआत कर सकता है, यह समान रूप से अनेक पूर्व-समयिक निर्णयों और दबाव-प्रेरित प्रतिबद्धताओं का भी अवसर देता है। इससे कई अस्थिर आत्माएँ आध्यात्मिक अस्थिरता में पड़ी रहती हैं और वर्षों तक उद्धार के आश्वासन की कमी से जूझती रहती हैं।

क्योंकि भले ही तुम्हारे मसीह में दस हज़ार उपदेशक हों, तब भी तुम्हारे बहुत से पिता नहीं हैं: क्योंकि मसीह यीशु में मैंने तुम्हें सुसमाचार के द्वारा जन्म दिया। इसलिये मैं तुमसे अनुरोध करता हूँ, मेरे अनुयायी बनो –1 कुरिन्थियों 4:15-16। परमेश्वर ने पिता और माताओं को, शारीरिक और आध्यात्मिक दोनों रूप से, अपने बच्चों को जन्म देने के लिये नियुक्त किया है।

मेरे अनुयायी बनो, जैसे कि मैं भी मसीह का अनुयायी हूँ –1 कुरिन्थियों 11:1। कुशल भ्रमणशील प्रचारक का उद्देश्य आध्यात्मिक बच्चों को जनम देना और स्वयं के अनुयायी बनाना नहीं होता। यह कार्य वह दूसरों के लिये छोड़ देता है, क्योंकि उसने अपने उपहार को लोगों को निर्णय लेने के लिये प्रेरित करने में पाया है।

और हम तुमसे प्रार्थना करते हैं, भाइयो, कि तुम उन लोगों को जानो जो तुम्हारे बीच परिश्रम करते हैं, और जो प्रभु में तुम्हारे ऊपर हैं, और जो तुम्हें उपदेश देते हैं; और उनके काम के कारण उन्हें बड़े प्रेम में बहुत मान करो… –1 थिस्सलुनीकियों 5:13। पर हमारे ऊपर परिश्रम करने वाले और हमें जन्म देने वाले आध्यात्मिक पिता-पड़ौसियों के प्रति परमेश्वर-प्रदान निष्ठा होनी चाहिए, जीवन के मार्ग पर अन्य कई उपदेशकों से ऊपर। हजारों “हिट एंड रन” मंत्रालयों का समसामयिक उदय हमें चिंतित होना चाहिए।

जबकि पाप की सार्वजनिक स्वीकारोक्ति स्पष्टतः उद्धार के साथ जुड़ी मसीह की एक महत्वपूर्ण शिक्षाओं में से है, ये स्वीकारोक्तियाँ उन आध्यात्मिक शक्तियों के हाथों में होनी चाहिए जो स्थिति का विवेक कर सकते हैं और आत्मा को आने वाले कल के प्रलोभनों में आगे बढ़ने के लिये सहायता प्रदान कर सकते हैं। जब परिवर्तित व्यक्ति को जानने वाले लोग व्यक्तिगत रूप से संलग्न होते हैं, तब अधिक गहन और ईमानदार परीक्षण अपनाकर सच्चा परिवर्तन लाया जा सकता है। यह चट्टान पर नींव रखने और आत्मा को घर व चर्च में स्थापित करने के लिये आवश्यक गहरी खुदाई का आधार तैयार करेगा।

…निर्मित विश्वास

जब लोग लगातार पुनरुत्थान दृश्यों के अधीन होते हैं, तो एक अनकहा पूर्वानुमान बन जाता है कि बैठकें परमेश्वर के साथ काम करने का स्थान हैं। इससे "उद्धारकारी विश्वास" और "उद्धारकारी कृत्य" के बीच भ्रम पैदा होने की प्रवृत्ति होती है। "आगे आकर मसीह को ग्रहण करो" पर जोर देने से विश्वास के अर्थ में भ्रम उत्पन्न होता है। मसीह वही दृढ़ सांत्वना है, जिसकी ओर हमने …शरण ली कि हम वहाँ रखी आशा को पकड़ सकें: जिस आशा को हमारे पास आत्मा की एक लंगर के रूप में है, जो निश्चय और अडिग है… –इब्रानियों 6:18-19। (प्रभाव मेरे द्वारा)

यीशु का निमन्त्रण …मेरे पास आओ… –मत्ती 11:28, को कभी भी "ऑल्टर की ओर आना" (सामने चलना) के साथ भ्रमित नहीं होना चाहिए। उपदेश की मूर्खता ही निमंत्रण है, और "मसीह" वह लक्ष्य है। वाग्पटुता की शक्ति प्रचारक की गतिशीलता में नहीं बल्कि संदेश की सच्चाई में पायी जानी चाहिए। हम कागज़ के पुतलों की भाँति हो जाते हैं, जिनमें अपने आप में कोई शक्ति नहीं है। सारी शक्ति ऊपर से आनी चाहिए; तथा जिन सभी विधियों का उपयोग किया जाता है वे भी ऊपर से आनी चाहिए। –वॉचमन नी***

हवा जहाँ चाहे बहती है… यूहन्ना 3:8, इसी प्रकार पवित्र आत्मा भी, और प्रचारक को उसी से संतुष्ट होना चाहिए। मुझे आशा है कि कई जो ऑल्टर कॉल देते हैं, उनके इरादे श्रेष्ठ होते हैं और वे आत्मा को पराजित करने की इच्छा नहीं रखते। परन्तु अधिकतर कार्य जो भावना के शिखर पर किए जाते हैं उनमें गलतियाँ होने की प्रवृत्ति प्रबल रहती है। तो विश्वास सुनने से उत्पन्न होता है, और सुनना परमेश्वर के वचन से—रोमियों 10:17।

Greetings of brotherly love to one and all. The year 2022 is almost gone. A lot has happened. Another year of devastating storms, floods, fires, earthquakes, wars, and rumors of wars. America has gone through another season of political elections, causing the conservatives and liberals to become even more polarized into opposing parties.

Recently, I have been reflecting on the current status of life as a committed Bible-believing Christian in our world today. Sure, there are certain places in our world where Christians live in constant threat of imprisonment or death simply because they are trying to live according to God’s Word. However, the world, seems to be moving towards an increasingly negative perspective of God’s people. In an increasingly developing trend, there is a surprising rise of hostility towards the committed believer.

What is happening? I have had numerous conversations with various believers from around the country who seem to have a growing alarm about the current victorious march of evil over good, of liberal agendas over a conservative lifestyle, and the list goes on. Current skyrocketing inflation, the potential of unprecedented heating costs for many, the rumors of rising interest rates, and the ongoing shortage of goods all tend to cause a person to be jolted out of a sense of normality.

For us as Christians, let us always keep our focus fixed on the God of heaven. This is the God that Paul declared on Mars Hill—God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands; Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things; –Acts 17:24-25.

Let’s stop focusing on the fact that evil seems to be prevailing and increasing around us and then concluding that somehow Satan has the upper hand right now. Rather, let us be reminded about what God’s Word says. But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived. But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them; And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus. All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works –2 Timothy 3:13-17.

Let us keep our eyes fixed on Jesus …the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God –Hebrews 12:2. Instead of believing Satan’s lie that he is somehow winning the battle for Truth right now, let’s remember that the Bible reveals that Satan can do nothing without God allowing him a temporary free rein. It seemed to those looking on that Satan had the complete upper hand when Jesus was crucified and buried. Surprise, surprise! Satan had unwittingly allowed God to use him to accomplish everything that had been prophesied throughout the Scriptures. It is the same today… God will again allow Satan whatever free rein is necessary to bring to fulfillment all that the Bible has foretold will come to pass regarding the end of time.

In this issue of the magazine, we have once more endeavored to bring you information in the articles that is both helpful and relevant to our time in history. Brother Leonard Martin, a bishop in one of our churches has shared an exhortation on spiritual gifts in the church with a number of clear, practical observations for us today. The article that we have chosen to share from “Bible Helps” in this issue is one of the best discourses on the subject of “faith and works” that I have ever read. The writer even delves, with biblical simplicity and clarity, into the controversial subjects of divine election and predestination. Finally, we have The Foolishness of Preaching an evaluation regarding the basis of churches using “the altar call”—is it founded in the Scriptures and the history of the church or is it a method that the church has borrowed from the world in more recent years?!

All of this is sure to stir thoughts and discussion—which is our goal with these types of articles. Please feel free to respond via email or regular mail with your thoughts of caution or encouragement. This is helpful for us and our writers. When you write, we also ask that you mention yes or no if we can use your questions or comments in our magazine. We have had various requests to establish a section in our magazine dedicated to hearing from our readers.

One final thought… over the years our readers have, at times, shared with us ways that they think we could improve our magazine for the good of all who read it and to present a more clear gospel message. We welcome this to continue.

May God richly bless each of you,

Curvin L. Wenger

Saluti di fraterna carità a tutti. L’anno 2022 è quasi passato. Molto è accaduto. Un altro anno di devastanti tempeste, inondazioni, incendi, terremoti, guerre e voci di guerre. L’America ha attraversato un’altra stagione di elezioni politiche, che ha portato conservatori e liberali a polarizzarsi ancora di più in partiti opposti.

Ultimamente ho riflettuto sullo stato attuale della vita come cristiano impegnato che crede nella Bibbia nel nostro mondo di oggi. Certo, ci sono luoghi del mondo dove i cristiani vivono nella minaccia costante di imprigionamento o morte semplicemente perché cercano di vivere secondo la Parola di Dio. Tuttavia, il mondo sembra muoversi verso una prospettiva sempre più negativa nei confronti del popolo di Dio. In una tendenza in crescita, c’è un sorprendente aumento dell’ostilità verso il credente impegnato.

Cosa sta succedendo? Ho avuto numerose conversazioni con vari credenti in tutto il paese che sembrano manifestare una crescente preoccupazione per l’attuale marcia vittoriosa del male sul bene, delle agende liberali su uno stile di vita conservatore, e l’elenco continua. L’impennata attuale dell’inflazione, la potenziale eccezionale crescita dei costi del riscaldamento per molti, le voci di aumento dei tassi di interesse e la continua carenza di beni tendono tutte a far sì che una persona venga scossa fuori da un senso di normalità.

Per noi cristiani, manteniamo sempre lo sguardo fisso sul Dio dei cieli. Questo è il Dio che Paolo dichiarò su Mars Hill—Dio che ha fatto il mondo e tutte le cose che sono in esso, vedendo che egli è Signore del cielo e della terra, non abita in templi fatti da mani; Né è adorato con le mani degli uomini, come se avesse bisogno di qualcosa, vedendo che egli dà a tutti vita, e respiro, e tutte le cose; –Atti 17:24-25.

Smettiamo di concentrarci sul fatto che il male sembra prevalere e aumentare intorno a noi e poi concludere che in qualche modo Satana abbia il sopravvento ora. Piuttosto, ricordiamo ciò che dice la Parola di Dio. Ma gli uomini malvagi e gli impostori cresceranno sempre più malvagi, seducendo e sedotti. Ma tu persevera nelle cose che hai apprese e di cui sei stato persuaso, sapendo da chi le hai apprese; E che fin da fanciullo hai conosciuto le sacre Scritture, che possono renderti saggio alla salvezza per mezzo della fede che è in Cristo Gesù. Ogni Scrittura è ispirata da Dio e utile per insegnamento, per riprensione, per correzione, per educazione alla giustizia: Affinché l’uomo di Dio sia completo, ben preparato per ogni opera buona –2 Timoteo 3:13-17.

Manteniamo gli occhi fissi su Gesù …l’autore e il perfezionatore della nostra fede; il quale, per la gioia che gli era posta davanti, sostenne la croce, disprezzando l’onta, e si è assiso alla destra del trono di Dio –Ebrei 12:2. Invece di credere alla bugia di Satana che in qualche modo stia vincendo la battaglia per la Verità adesso, ricordiamo che la Bibbia rivela che Satana non può fare nulla senza che Dio gli permetta temporaneamente mano libera. Agli occhi di chi guardava sembrava che Satana avesse il completo sopravvento quando Gesù fu crocifisso e sepolto. Sorpresa, sorpresa! Satana aveva involontariamente permesso a Dio di usarlo per compiere tutto ciò che era stato profetizzato nelle Scritture. Oggi è lo stesso… Dio permetterà ancora a Satana tutta la mano libera necessaria per portare a compimento tutto ciò che la Bibbia ha predetto avverrà riguardo alla fine dei tempi.

In questo numero della rivista, ci siamo ancora una volta impegnati a portarvi informazioni negli articoli che siano utili e pertinenti al nostro tempo nella storia. Il fratello Leonard Martin, un vescovo in una delle nostre chiese, ha condiviso un’esortazione sui doni spirituali nella chiesa con una serie di osservazioni chiare e pratiche per noi oggi. L’articolo che abbiamo scelto di condividere da “Bible Helps” in questo numero è uno dei migliori discorsi sull’argomento “fede e opere” che abbia mai letto. L’autore si addentra persino, con semplicità e chiarezza biblica, nei controversi argomenti dell’elezione divina e della predestinazione. Infine, abbiamo La follia della predicazione, una valutazione riguardo alla base delle chiese che usano «la chiamata all’altare»—è fondata nelle Scritture e nella storia della chiesa o è un metodo che la chiesa ha preso in prestito dal mondo in anni più recenti?!

Tutto ciò sicuramente susciterà pensieri e discussioni—che è il nostro obiettivo con questo tipo di articoli. Sentitevi liberi di rispondere via e-mail o posta ordinaria con i vostri pensieri di cautela o di incoraggiamento. Questo è utile per noi e per i nostri scrittori. Quando scrivete, vi chiediamo anche di indicare sì o no se possiamo usare le vostre domande o commenti nella nostra rivista. Abbiamo avuto varie richieste per istituire una sezione nella nostra rivista dedicata a sentire i nostri lettori.

Un ultimo pensiero… nel corso degli anni i nostri lettori ci hanno talvolta fatto conoscere modi in cui pensano che potremmo migliorare la nostra rivista per il bene di tutti coloro che la leggono e per presentare un messaggio evangelico più chiaro. Accogliamo con favore che ciò continui.

Che Dio benedica abbondantemente ciascuno di voi,

Curvin L. Wenger

Lunchtime was over and it was that delightful hour of the day when mom said it was time for a break. Since Ellie was ten, she wasn’t required to take a daily nap anymore, so she set about trying to decide just how she would spend this free time. She loved being outdoors, so the sunny skies and fresh air of this particularly lovely summer day fairly pulled her outside.

“I know!” she thought to herself. “This would be a perfect time to try some whittling with that knife Paul gave me.”

She had spent a week with her aunt and uncle who lived several counties over from hers and while there, her cousin Paul had given her a knife that he had made. It had a short, round handle and he had inserted a small piece of steel into one end. He then honed the blade to a nice sharp edge. He could carve the funniest little faces on small blocks of wood and Ellie was always eager to see what he would create next. She tried to copy him, but it didn’t seem as if she would be turning out anything very exciting any time soon. Still, it was fun to try, so she got the knife from her drawer in her bedroom and headed outside.

The large maple tree in front of their old stone farmhouse beckoned to her. Its low hanging branches seemed like the perfect place to perch and try out that knife again. Ellie selected a few large twigs and then hoisted herself up into the cool shade of the tree. Once situated, she began cutting and picking away at her pieces of wood. She still couldn’t make eyes and a nose appear, but she had fun carving notches and shaving off small pieces of bark. It was a relaxing thing with which to be occupied while enjoying the quietness of the afternoon. She was so glad this tree was in their yard, and she was so glad that Paul had given her that whittling knife.

After a time, the branch Ellie was sitting on began to feel rough and hard, and the twigs she was whittling had nearly disappeared. “I should go see what the boys are doing,” she thought. She shifted to the lowest branch and sat poised, ready to jump down like she always did to get out of the tree.

She paused, looking at the knife in her hand. “Never jump down from anywhere while holding a knife in your hand!” her mother’s voice rang in her memory. “It is a very dangerous thing to do. You could get cut very badly.” Ellie sat thinking about that for a little.

“Yes, I know that’s probably true,” she told herself. “But I think if I am very careful, I could jump down and it will be fine,” she reasoned.

She firmly grasped the knife in her right hand, then quickly jumped the distance to the ground. Just as she landed, her ankle turned and gave way under her. She fell awkwardly onto her left leg. And, oh no! That little knife had plunged into her left wrist as she was trying to keep her balance. She quickly pulled it out and watched, with her heart beating rapidly, as the blood welled up, dark and warm. It was a small cut, only about one quarter of an inch long, but it had gone in rather deeply.

What should she do now? Yes, there was no doubt about it, her mom had been right after all! In her heart, she knew the right thing to do would be to go directly to her mother and tell her what she had done. But she felt guilty and ashamed. She had known better than to jump down with that knife, yet she had gone ahead and done it anyway. Guiltily, she quickly pressed her thumb on top of the wound and slipped into the house. The bleeding soon stopped, and after finding a little bandage and placing it on her cut, she quietly put her knife away and found a book to read. She never told her mom what she had done until many years later when she was a grown woman.

Today, as she looks at that scar, which is still visible from 40 years ago, she wonders why God had protected her. She had been a foolish little girl to not go immediately to her mother and confess what she had done. She could have gotten a severe infection from getting cut with a dirty, slightly rusty knife. Even though she acted foolishly, she is grateful that God protected her, but she still wishes she had confessed her disobedience to her mother.

It is never wise to hide anything from your parents. They need to know those wrong things you do, no matter how embarrassed or ashamed you might feel. Parents need to know all the things that happen to their children It is God’s design for fathers and mothers to be there for their children, to help you when you get hurt, and to guide and teach you as you learn how to be good, obedient children. God’s way is always the best.

Το μεσημεριανό είχε τελειώσει και ήταν εκείνη η ευχάριστη ώρα της ημέρας όταν η μαμά έλεγε ότι ήταν ώρα για ξεκούραση. Επειδή η Έλι ήταν δέκα χρονών, δεν ήταν πια υποχρεωμένη να παίρνει καθημερινό υπνάκο, οπότε άρχισε να αποφασίζει πώς θα περάσει αυτόν τον ελεύθερο χρόνο. Της άρεσε να βρίσκεται έξω, έτσι ο ηλιόλουστος ουρανός και ο καθαρός αέρας αυτής της ιδιαίτερα όμορφης καλοκαιρινής μέρας την τράβηξαν σχεδόν έξω.

«Ξέρω!» σκέφτηκε μέσα της. «Αυτή θα ήταν μια τέλεια στιγμή να δοκιμάσω λίγο ξυλογλυπτική με εκείνο το μαχαίρι που μου έδωσε ο Πολ.»

Είχε περάσει μια εβδομάδα με τη θεία και τον θείο της που ζούσαν σε μία γειτονική κομητεία και ενώ ήταν εκεί, ο ξάδερφός της Πολ της είχε δώσει ένα μαχαίρι που είχε φτιάξει ο ίδιος. Είχε μια κοντή, στρογγυλή λαβή και είχε βάλει ένα μικρό κομμάτι χάλυβα στο ένα άκρο. Έπειτα είχε ακονίσει τη λάμα σε μια ωραία κοφτερή ακμή. Μπορούσε να σκαλίσει τα πιο αστεία προσωπάκια σε μικρά ξύλινα κομμάτια και η Έλι πάντα ανυπομονούσε να δει τι θα δημιουργούσε στη συνέχεια. Προσπάθησε να τον μιμηθεί, αλλά δεν φαινόταν πως σύντομα θα έκανε κάτι πολύ εντυπωσιακό. Παρ’ όλα αυτά, της άρεσε να προσπαθεί, οπότε πήρε το μαχαίρι από το συρτάρι στο δωμάτιό της και βγήκε έξω.

Η μεγάλη σφενδάμνια μπροστά από το παλιό τους πέτρινο αγροτόσπιτο την καλούσε. Τα χαμηλά κρεμαστά κλαδιά της φάνηκαν το τέλειο μέρος για να καθίσει και να δοκιμάσει ξανά εκείνο το μαχαίρι. Η Έλι διάλεξε μερικά μεγάλα κλαδάκια και μετά σκαρφάλωσε στο δροσερό ίσκιο του δέντρου. Μόλις βολεύτηκε, άρχισε να κόβει και να ξύνει τα κομμάτια ξύλου της. Ακόμα δεν μπορούσε να φτιάξει μάτια και μύτη, αλλά διασκέδαζε σκαλίζοντας εγκοπές και ξυρίζοντας μικρά κομμάτια φλούδας. Ήταν κάτι χαλαρωτικό με το οποίο ασχολιόταν απολαμβάνοντας τη γαλήνη του απογεύματος. Χαιρόταν πολύ που το δέντρο αυτό ήταν στην αυλή τους, και ήταν πολύ χαρούμενη που ο Πολ της είχε δώσει εκείνο το μαχαίρι για ξυλογλυπτική.

Μετά από λίγο, το κλαδί στο οποίο καθόταν η Έλι άρχισε να γίνεται τραχύ και σκληρό, και τα κλαδάκια που ξυλογλύπτονταν είχαν σχεδόν εξαφανιστεί. «Πρέπει να δω τι κάνουν τα αγόρια», σκέφτηκε. Μετακινήθηκε στο χαμηλότερο κλαδί και κάθισε έτοιμη, έτοιμη να πηδήξει κάτω όπως πάντα για να βγει από το δέντρο.

Παύση, κοίταξε το μαχαίρι στο χέρι της. «Ποτέ μην πηδάς από κανένα μέρος κρατώντας μαχαίρι στο χέρι!» η φωνή της μητέρας της αντήχησε στη μνήμη της. «Είναι κάτι πολύ επικίνδυνο. Μπορεί να κοπείς πολύ άσχημα.» Η Έλι έκατσε και το σκέφτηκε λίγο.

«Ναι, ξέρω ότι πιθανότατα αυτό είναι αλήθεια», είπε μέσα της. «Αλλά νομίζω ότι αν είμαι πολύ προσεκτική, θα μπορούσα να πηδήξω και θα γίνει καλά», συλλογίστηκε.

Έπιασε γερά το μαχαίρι στο δεξί της χέρι και μετά γρήγορα πήδηξε στο έδαφος. Μόλις προσγειώθηκε, ο αστράγαλός της στράβωσε και λύγισε κάτω από αυτήν. Έπεσε άσχημα στο αριστερό της πόδι. Και, ωχ όχι! εκείνο το μικρό μαχαίρι είχε βυθιστεί στον αριστερό καρπό της καθώς προσπαθούσε να κρατήσει την ισορροπία της. Το τράβηξε γρήγορα έξω και παρακολούθησε, με την καρδιά της να χτυπά γρήγορα, το αίμα να βγαίνει, σκοτεινό και ζεστό. Ήταν μια μικρή κοπή, μόλις περίπου ένα τέταρτο της ίντσας, αλλά είχε μπει αρκετά βαθιά.

Τι να κάνει τώρα; Ναι, δεν υπήρχε αμφιβολία, η μαμά της είχε δίκιο τελικά! Στην καρδιά της ήξερε ότι το σωστό θα ήταν να πάει αμέσως στη μητέρα της και να της πει τι είχε κάνει. Αλλά ένιωθε ένοχη και ντροπιασμένη. Ήξερε πως δεν έπρεπε να πηδήξει κρατώντας εκείνο το μαχαίρι, και παρ’ όλα αυτά το είχε κάνει. Με ενοχή, πάτησε γρήγορα τον αντίχειρά της πάνω από το τραύμα και μπήκε στο σπίτι. Η αιμορραγία σύντομα σταμάτησε, και αφού βρήκε ένα μικρό αυτοκόλλητο επίδεσμο και το τοποθέτησε στο κόψιμο, σιωπηλά έβαλε το μαχαίρι στη θέση του και βρήκε ένα βιβλίο να διαβάσει. Δεν είπε ποτέ στη μαμά της τι είχε κάνει μέχρι πολλά χρόνια αργότερα, όταν ήταν πια ενήλικας.

Σήμερα, καθώς κοιτάζει αυτή την ουλή, που είναι ακόμα ορατή από πριν σαράντα χρόνια, αναρωτιέται γιατί ο Θεός την είχε προστατέψει. Είχε υπάρξει ένα ανόητο μικρό κορίτσι που δεν πήγε αμέσως στη μητέρα της να εξομολογήσει αυτό που είχε κάνει. Θα μπορούσε να είχε πάθει σοβαρή μόλυνση από το κόψιμο με ένα βρώμικο, ελαφρώς σκουριασμένο μαχαίρι. Παρ’ όλο που συμπεριφέρθηκε ανόητα, είναι ευγνώμων που ο Θεός την προστάτεψε, αλλά εξακολουθεί να εύχεται να είχε εξομολογηθεί την ανυπακοή της στη μητέρα της.

Δεν είναι ποτέ σοφό να κρύβεις οτιδήποτε από τους γονείς σου. Πρέπει να γνωρίζουν τα λάθη που κάνεις, όση ντροπή ή ταπείνωση και αν νιώθεις. Οι γονείς πρέπει να γνωρίζουν όλα όσα συμβαίνουν στα παιδιά τους. Είναι σχέδιο του Θεού οι πατέρες και οι μητέρες να είναι εκεί για τα παιδιά τους, να σε βοηθούν όταν τραυματίζεσαι και να σε καθοδηγούν και να σε διδάσκουν καθώς μαθαίνεις πώς να είσαι καλό, υπάκουο παιδί. Ο τρόπος του Θεού είναι πάντα ο καλύτερος.

The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, To preach the acceptable year of the Lord –Luke 4:18-19.

Jesus was in His hometown of Nazareth. It was on the Sabbath, and He stood to read the scripture as He had in the past. This Sabbath He read from Isaiah 61. When He finished, He said, …This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears –Luke 4:21.

This marked the beginning of Jesus’ earthly ministry. In this first sermon He described the nature of His ministry. Notice the many references in this passage to healing: healing to the brokenhearted, deliverance to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, and liberty to the bruised. Jesus came to provide a remedy for our brokenness. He came to repair the damage that sin has brought into humanity.

In this article we will look at the possibility for healing that is found in Jesus. Healing is a process that requires inner restoration with outside remediation. Physical healing begins at the cellular level and restores physical function. Spiritual healing begins at the heart level and restores us to fullness of life. Jesus said, …I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly – John 10:10.

As Jesus walked the dusty paths of Judea, He encountered many who needed physical healing. It was His ability to heal that drew many to seek Him out and to follow him. Many brought their friends and family to Him for healing. There is in all of us a desire for healing and wholeness. In the garden of Eden, mankind was created to be whole. When we are not whole, we seek every possible cure. So, crowds gathered around Jesus hoping for healing.

One day as Jesus was journeying through Jericho, a blind man, Bartimaeus, heard that He was approaching. Hope sprang up in his breast. He began to call out to Jesus, “Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.” They tried to silence him, but he called the louder, “Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.”

He cast his coat aside and blindly rushed into the street. Jesus said to him, “What wilt thou that I should do unto thee?” He said, “Lord, that I might receive my sight.” Jesus’ response to this simple faith was, “Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole.” Immediately, he received his sight, and followed Jesus. This is just one example of Jesus’ healing ministry. The examples are many. He healed lepers. He healed paralytics. He healed men and women of unclean spirits.

Does Jesus still heal in our day? I would like to answer that question by sharing my own journey of healing. I realize that not all are healed. Even in Jesus’ day, not all were healed. But I want to share my journey of healing to demonstrate the interconnectedness of the physical and the spiritual.

I was diagnosed with cancer in May of 2020. Hearing a doctor say, “You have millions of cancer cells in your body”, brought me face to face with my mortality like never before. Oh, I knew that someday I would die, but that was always somewhere in the far distant future. Now I needed to face the fact that I had a disease growing within me which had the potential to destroy my body.

Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him. Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much –James 5:14-16.

I have always been a strong advocate of anointing with oil. Just like we are taught in the book of James, I called for the elders of the church and asked them to anoint me with oil. In the biblical teaching of God healing through the anointing with oil there are a number of things that are expected of those seeking the healing. There is: call[ing] for the elders of the church, the prayer of faith, pray[ing] one for another, Confess[ing] your faults one to another, the effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man… and the list goes on. So, one of the necessities to seek healing through the anointing with oil is the clearing of the heart of any known, unconfessed sin. Hence, I searched my heart and cleansed my heart of anything that would hinder God’s healing of my body.

Notice the close correlation in this passage between the physical and the spiritual. I found in my journey of healing that the one affects the other. Physical healing begins with spiritual healing. A few drops of oil have no therapeutic benefit. This anointing with oil is primarily a spiritual exercise. If we practice this ordinance as James offered it, we cleanse our hearts inwardly and then we ask God for physical healing.

This was my first step to healing, but a long journey lay ahead. We consulted with multiple doctors and eventually we chose a treatment protocol that included radiation and hormone therapy. This treatment weakened me physically and made me feel my humanity. It made me more dependent on God and others and less confident in my own abilities. Living with weakness caused me to draw my strength from my Heavenly Father Who is the source of strength. I relied heavily on the encouragement and support that my wife and family offered.

There are some lessons that can only be learned through human weakness. It was for this reason that Paul was given a thorn in the flesh. He sought the Lord three times for healing. God’s answer came back always the same, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my strength is made perfect in your weakness.” I can testify that that is true.

I had multiple radiation treatments in January of 2021. I had scheduled a series of meetings for the month of February thinking that my treatments would be over, and I would be back to normal. What I did not realize was the delayed effect of radiation. I breezed through the treatments, but in February I experienced a lot of digestive issues and a lot of physical weakness.

I was expected to deliver a series of four sermons on four consecutive evenings. We prayed and although I could not get through the day without napping God provided supernatural strength for those evening messages. I praise God that His strength was made perfect in my weakness.

My doctors have plied their trade. I am grateful for the professional medical care that I received. I have done what I could with herbs and supplements and God has been merciful. My last bloodwork came back “undetectable”. May God be praised!

I am sharing my experience to show the correlation between the physical and the spiritual. Physical illness in my experience had a sanctifying effect on my spirit and spiritual renewal conditioned my body for healing. I will be forever grateful for the professional care given by my doctors, but even they realize the limits of their profession. On my last visit to my Medical Oncologist, he said to me, “Now we are going to trust the Lord.” Thank God for God-fearing doctors!

There are several examples in scripture that demonstrate this correlation between physical and spiritual healing. In Mark 2 when they let the paralytic down through the roof into the presence of Jesus, He said to the paralytic, “Thy sins be forgiven thee.” Then He said, “Rise up and walk.” When He was challenged by the Pharisees for forgiving sins, He said to them, “Which is easier to say rise up and walk or thy sins be forgiven”, demonstrating that He had the power to do both. If we believe that Jesus has the power to forgive our sins, do we also believe that He has the power to heal our bodies? I do!

In John 5, Jesus healed a man who lay by the pool of Bethesda. He had this infirmity for thirty-eight years. Jesus came by and healed him. Later when He met him in the temple He said to him, “Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.” Note the correlation between the physical and the spiritual.

Physical infirmity has a tremendous potential to open our hearts to spiritual realities if we allow it to. The Psalmist said: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word –Psalm 119:67. Jesus said: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, To preach the acceptable year of the Lord –Luke 4:18-19.

Take a fresh look at our proof text for this article and notice that Jesus is offering more than physical healing. He promises healing to the brokenhearted, deliverance to the captives, and liberty to the bruised. These promises are of emotional healing—healing for the hurt that we receive as a result of living in a broken, sin-cursed world.

I am sure that there are many people reading this article who have experienced trauma that I know nothing about. But I want to assure you that you can be healed. Do you believe that? Do you believe that the pain can go away? Do you believe that you can be delivered from fear, anxiety, anger, and bitterness?

We addressed the correlation between spiritual and physical healing. There is also a correlation between spiritual and emotional healing. If you are experiencing a broken heart, Jesus wants to heal your broken heart. If you are a captive—if you are bound to a past or to an addiction that prevents your freedom—Jesus will set you free. If you have been bruised Jesus will heal you.

My wife and I are appalled at the large number of people in our Anabaptist churches that are turning to psych drugs (mind medication) and secular counseling to find solutions for emotional disorders. The Bible addresses most emotional disorders:

Fear

  • There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear –1 John 4:18.
  • What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee –Psalm 56:3.
  • “Fear not” is found 63 times in the Bible

Anxiety

  • Be careful [anxious] for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God –Philippians 4:6.

Anger

  • Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice –Ephesians 4:31.

This is just a sampling of emotional disorders that we encounter in life, and I realize that behind these emotions there is often deep-seated trauma. Your trauma is not an astonishment to Jesus. He may not have experienced your exact trauma, but he has gone to the depth of your pain, and he has come through it in victory.

For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin. Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need –Hebrews 4:15-16.

The gospel provides a holistic remedy to man’s sin problem. Our Anabaptist heritage has emphasized the fact that faith in Jesus affects every area of our lives. This faith motivates us to follow Jesus in very practical ways in our daily lives. This results in a life of radical nonconformity to the world around us.

This radical discipleship should also affect our emotional responses to difficult people and circumstances. Or have we become so emotionally fragile that if life does not give us exactly what we want it upsets our emotional equilibrium? Or maybe the gospel that we preach has become a litany of words that appeases the mind but has no effect on our soul.

Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it. For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it –Hebrews 4:1-2. Is our faith in God so weak (remember that in the Biblical accounts of healing, it was their faith that enabled the healing) that we have more faith in medication or in a board-certified secular counselor than we have in God and His Word?

This is a discipleship series. Come with me to the mountain where Jesus is teaching. Yes, there is a large crowd, but follow me closely, we will try to get close enough to hear. I hear His voice—He is saying something about “salt of the earth” and “light of the world.” Here is an empty space—just room for two. Let’s sit on the grass and listen:

“Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also. And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain. Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy. But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you; That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.”

These are radical teachings. Radical in that they are so opposite from our natural inclinations, and yet, this is the way of peace. Most of our negative emotions such as anger, fear, and anxiety can be remedied by applying these teachings of Jesus to our situations. This may sound overly simplistic, but that is the nature of the gospel and millions of people have found life and freedom through faith in Christ.

Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies; Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s –Psalm 103:1-5.

O Espírito do Senhor é sobre mim, porque me ungiu para evangelizar os pobres; enviou‑me para curar os quebrantados de coração; para pregar liberdade aos cativos e restauração de vista aos cegos; para pôr em liberdade os oprimidos, para proclamar o ano aceitável do Senhor –Lucas 4:18-19.

Jesus estava em Sua cidade natal, Nazaré. Era sábado, e Ele se levantou para ler as Escrituras como havia feito no passado. Naquele sábado leu de Isaías 61. Quando terminou, disse: …Hoje se cumpriu esta escritura aos vossos ouvidos –Lucas 4:21.

Isto marcou o começo do ministério terreno de Jesus. Neste primeiro sermão Ele descreveu a natureza de Seu ministério. Note as muitas referências nesta passagem à cura: cura dos quebrantados de coração, libertação dos cativos, restauração da vista aos cegos e liberdade para os oprimidos. Jesus veio proporcionar um remédio para a nossa fragilidade. Ele veio reparar o dano que o pecado trouxe à humanidade.

Neste artigo examinaremos a possibilidade de cura que se encontra em Jesus. A cura é um processo que requer restauração interior juntamente com remediação externa. A cura física começa ao nível celular e restaura a função corporal. A cura espiritual começa ao nível do coração e nos restaura à plenitude da vida. Jesus disse: …Eu vim para que tenham vida, e a tenham com abundância –João 10:10.

Enquanto Jesus caminhava pelos caminhos empoeirados da Judeia, Ele encontrou muitos que necessitavam de cura física. Foi Sua capacidade de curar que atraiu muitos a procurá‑Lo e a segui‑Lo. Muitos traziam amigos e familiares a Ele para serem curados. Há em todos nós um desejo por cura e integridade. No jardim do Éden, a humanidade foi criada para ser inteira. Quando não estamos inteiros, procuramos todo remédio possível. Assim, multidões se ajuntavam em torno de Jesus na esperança de cura.

Um dia, enquanto Jesus passava por Jericó, um cego, Bartimeu, soube que Ele estava se aproximando. A esperança brotou em seu peito. Começou a clamar a Jesus: “Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim.” Tentaram fazê‑lo calar, mas ele clamou mais alto: “Jesus, Filho de Davi, tem misericórdia de mim.”

Ele lançou de si o manto e, às cegas, correu para a rua. Jesus lhe disse: “Que queres que eu te faça?” Ele respondeu: “Senhor, para que eu veja.” A resposta de Jesus àquela fé simples foi: “Vai, a tua fé te salvou.” Imediatamente recebeu a vista e seguiu a Jesus. Este é apenas um exemplo do ministério de cura de Jesus. Os exemplos são muitos. Ele curou leprosos. Curou paralíticos. Curou homens e mulheres de espíritos imundos.

Jesus ainda cura em nossos dias? Gostaria de responder a essa pergunta compartilhando minha própria jornada de cura. Reconheço que nem todos são curados. Mesmo nos dias de Jesus, nem todos eram curados. Mas quero partilhar minha jornada de cura para demonstrar a interconexão entre o físico e o espiritual.

Fui diagnosticado com câncer em maio de 2020. Ouvir um médico dizer: “Você tem milhões de células cancerígenas em seu corpo”, confrontou‑me com minha mortalidade como nunca antes. Ah, eu sabia que um dia morreria, mas isso sempre esteve num futuro distante. Agora eu precisava encarar o fato de que havia uma doença crescendo dentro de mim com potencial de destruir meu corpo.

Há algum enfermo entre vós? chame os presbíteros da igreja, e orem sobre ele, ungindo‑o com óleo em nome do Senhor: E a oração da fé salvará o doente, e o Senhor o levantará; e, se houver cometido pecados, ser-lhe‑ão perdoados. Confessai as vossas culpas uns aos outros, e orai uns pelos outros, para que sareis. A oração eficaz e fervente do justo pode muito –Tiago 5:14-16.

Sempre fui um firme defensor da unção com óleo. Assim como somos ensinados no livro de Tiago, chamei os presbíteros da igreja e pedi que me ungissem com óleo. No ensino bíblico sobre Deus curando mediante a unção com óleo há uma série de coisas que se espera daqueles que buscam a cura. Há: chamar os presbíteros da igreja, a oração da fé, orar uns pelos outros, confessar as vossas culpas uns aos outros, a oração eficaz e fervente do justo… e a lista continua. Portanto, uma das necessidades para buscar cura pela unção com óleo é a purificação do coração de qualquer pecado conhecido e não confessado. Assim, examinei meu coração e o limpei de qualquer coisa que pudesse impedir a cura do meu corpo por Deus.

Note a estreita correlação nesta passagem entre o físico e o espiritual. Descobri em minha jornada de cura que um afeta o outro. A cura física começa com a cura espiritual. Algumas gotas de óleo não têm benefício terapêutico. Esta unção com óleo é, primordialmente, um exercício espiritual. Se praticarmos esta ordenança como Tiago a propôs, purificamos nosso coração interiormente e então pedimos a Deus pela cura física.

Este foi meu primeiro passo para a cura, mas um longo caminho estava à frente. Consultamos vários médicos e, por fim, escolhemos um protocolo de tratamento que incluiu radioterapia e terapia hormonal. Esse tratamento me enfraqueceu fisicamente e fez‑me sentir minha humanidade. Tornou‑me mais dependente de Deus e dos outros, e menos confiante em minhas próprias habilidades. Viver na fraqueza levou‑me a extrair minha força do meu Pai Celestial, que é a fonte de força. Dependi fortemente do encorajamento e do apoio que minha esposa e família me ofereceram.

Há lições que só podem ser aprendidas por meio da fraqueza humana. Foi por esta razão que Paulo recebeu um espinho na carne. Ele rogou ao Senhor três vezes por cura. A resposta de Deus foi sempre a mesma: “A minha graça te basta, porque o meu poder se aperfeiçoa na fraqueza.” Posso testemunhar que isso é verdade.

Submeti‑me a múltiplas sessões de radioterapia em janeiro de 2021. Havia agendado uma série de encontros para o mês de fevereiro, imaginando que meus tratamentos terminariam e que eu voltaria ao normal. O que eu não percebera foi o efeito retardado da radioterapia. Passei pelas sessões, mas em fevereiro experimentei muitos problemas digestivos e grande fraqueza física.

Era esperado que eu pregasse uma série de quatro sermões por quatro noites consecutivas. Oramos e, embora eu não conseguisse passar o dia sem cochilar, Deus providenciou força sobrenatural para aquelas mensagens noturnas. Louvo a Deus porque Sua força se aperfeiçoou na minha fraqueza.

Meus médicos exerceram sua arte. Sou grato pelo cuidado médico profissional que recebi. Fiz o que pude com ervas e suplementos e Deus foi misericordioso. Meus últimos exames de sangue voltaram “indetectáveis”. Louvado seja Deus!

Compartilho minha experiência para mostrar a correlação entre o físico e o espiritual. A enfermidade física, na minha experiência, teve um efeito santificador sobre meu espírito, e a renovação espiritual condicionou meu corpo para a cura. Serei eternamente grato pelo cuidado profissional dos meus médicos, mas até eles reconhecem os limites de sua profissão. Na minha última visita ao oncologista clínico, ele me disse: “Agora vamos confiar no Senhor.” Graças a Deus por médicos tementes a Deus!

Há vários exemplos nas Escrituras que demonstram essa correlação entre cura física e espiritual. Em Marcos 2, quando deixaram o paralítico descer pelo telhado até a presença de Jesus, Ele disse ao paralítico: “Teus pecados te são perdoados.” Depois disse: “Levanta‑te e anda.” Quando foi desafiado pelos fariseus por perdoar pecados, Ele lhes disse: “Que é mais fácil dizer levanta‑te e anda ou teus pecados te são perdoados?”, demonstrando que tinha poder para fazer ambas as coisas. Se cremos que Jesus tem poder para perdoar nossos pecados, também cremos que Ele tem poder para curar nossos corpos? Eu creio!

Em João 5, Jesus curou um homem que jazia junto ao tanque de Betesda. Ele tinha essa enfermidade por trinta e oito anos. Jesus passou e o curou. Mais tarde, quando o encontrou no templo, disse‑lhe: “Eis que já estás são; não peques mais, para que não te suceda coisa pior.” Observe a correlação entre o físico e o espiritual.

A enfermidade física tem grande potencial para abrir nossos corações às realidades espirituais, se permitirmos. O salmista disse: Antes que eu fosse afligido, andava errado; mas agora guardo a tua palavra –Salmo 119:67. Jesus disse: O Espírito do Senhor é sobre mim, porque me ungiu para evangelizar os pobres; enviou‑me para curar os quebrantados de coração; para pregar liberdade aos cativos e restauração de vista aos cegos; para pôr em liberdade os oprimidos, para proclamar o ano aceitável do Senhor –Lucas 4:18-19.

Observe novamente nosso texto base para este artigo e perceba que Jesus está oferecendo mais do que cura física. Ele promete cura aos quebrantados de coração, libertação aos cativos e liberdade aos oprimidos. Essas promessas são de cura emocional — cura para a dor que sofremos como consequência de viver num mundo quebrado e maculado pelo pecado.

Tenho certeza de que há muitas pessoas lendo este artigo que passaram por traumas dos quais eu nada sei. Mas quero assegurar‑vos que vós podeis ser curados. Credes nisso? Credes que a dor pode desaparecer? Credes que podeis ser libertos do medo, da ansiedade, da ira e da amargura?

Discutimos a correlação entre cura espiritual e física. Há também uma correlação entre cura espiritual e emocional. Se estás com o coração quebrantado, Jesus quer curar teu coração. Se és um cativo — se estás preso a um passado ou a um vício que impede tua liberdade — Jesus te libertará. Se foste ferido, Jesus te curará.

Minha esposa e eu estamos consternados com o grande número de pessoas em nossas igrejas anabatistas que recorrem a medicamentos psiquiátricos (medicação para a mente) e a aconselhamento secular para encontrar soluções para transtornos emocionais. A Bíblia trata da maioria dos transtornos emocionais:

Medo

  • Não existe medo no amor; ao contrário, o amor perfeito lança fora o medo –1 João 4:18.
  • Quando eu estiver com medo, confiarei em ti –Salmo 56:3.
  • “Não temas” aparece 63 vezes na Bíblia

Ansiedade

  • Não estejais inquietos por coisa alguma; antes, em tudo, pela oração e súplica com ação de graças, sejam as vossas petições conhecidas diante de Deus –Filipenses 4:6.

Ira

  • Rejeitai toda amargura, e cólera, e ira, e gritaria, e blasfêmias, bem como toda malícia –Efésios 4:31.

Isto é apenas uma amostra dos transtornos emocionais que encontramos na vida, e reconheço que por trás dessas emoções frequentemente há traumas profundos. Teu trauma não é surpresa para Jesus. Talvez Ele não tenha experimentado exatamente o teu trauma, mas Ele penetrou a profundidade da tua dor e saiu vitorioso dela.

Porque não temos sumo sacerdote que não possa compadecer‑se das nossas fraquezas; porém, um que, em tudo, foi tentado tal como nós, sem pecado. Cheguemos, pois, ousadamente ao trono da graça, para alcançarmos misericórdia e encontrarmos graça, a fim de sermos ajudados em tempo oportuno –Hebreus 4:15-16.

O evangelho fornece um remédio holístico para o problema do pecado do homem. Nossa herança anabatista enfatizou o fato de que a fé em Jesus afeta toda área da nossa vida. Essa fé nos motiva a seguir Jesus de maneiras muito práticas no cotidiano. Isso resulta numa vida de não conformidade radical ao mundo que nos cerca.

Esse discipulado radical também deveria afetar nossas respostas emocionais a pessoas e circunstâncias difíceis. Ou será que nos tornamos tão emocionalmente frágeis que, se a vida não nos dá exatamente o que queremos, nosso equilíbrio emocional se abala? Ou talvez o evangelho que pregamos tenha se tornado um repertório de palavras que apazigua a mente, mas não toca a alma.

Temamos, pois, para que, não sucedendo que alguma promessa ficando‑nos de entrar no seu descanso, algum de vós pareça chegar a não a alcançar. Pois a nós foi anunciada a boa nova como também a eles; mas a palavra pregada não lhes aproveitou, por não estar misturada com fé naqueles que a ouviram –Hebreus 4:1-2. Nossa fé em Deus é tão fraca (lembrai que nos relatos bíblicos da cura, era a fé deles que possibilitava a cura) que temos mais fé em medicamentos ou em um conselheiro secular credenciado do que em Deus e em Sua Palavra?

Esta é uma série de discipulado. Venha comigo ao monte onde Jesus está ensinando. Sim, há uma grande multidão, mas siga‑me de perto; vamos tentar nos aproximar o suficiente para ouvir. Ouço Sua voz — Ele está dizendo algo sobre “sal da terra” e “luz do mundo”. Aqui há um espaço vazio — há lugar apenas para dois. Sentemo‑nos na relva e ouçamos:

“Ouvistes que foi dito: Olho por olho, e dente por dente. Mas eu vos digo: Não resistais ao perverso; antes, qualquer que te ferir na face direita, volta‑lhe também a outra.

E, se alguém quiser pleitear contigo e tirar‑te a túnica, deixa‑lhe também o manto. E, se alguém te obrigar a caminhar uma milha, vai com ele duas. Dá a quem te pedir, e não voltes as costas ao que quiser tomar emprestado de ti.

Ouvistes que foi dito: Amarás o teu próximo e odiarás o teu inimigo. Mas eu vos digo: Amai os vossos inimigos, abençoai os que vos maldizem, fazei bem aos que vos odeiam, e orai pelos que vos perseguem; para que sejais filhos do vosso Pai que está nos céus; porque ele faz nascer o seu sol sobre maus e bons, e faz chover sobre justos e injustos.”

São ensinamentos radicais. Radicais por serem tão opostos às nossas inclinações naturais, e ainda assim este é o caminho da paz. A maioria de nossas emoções negativas, tais como ira, medo e ansiedade, pode ser remediada aplicando‑se esses ensinamentos de Jesus às nossas situações. Isso pode soar excessivamente simples, mas essa é a natureza do evangelho e milhões de pessoas encontraram vida e liberdade mediante fé em Cristo.

Bendize, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR, e tudo o que há em mim bendiga o seu santo nome. Bendize, ó minha alma, ao SENHOR, e não te esqueças de nenhum de seus benefícios: que perdoa todas as tuas iniquidades; que sara todas as tuas enfermidades; que redime a tua vida da perdição; que te coroa de benignidade e de misericórdias; que farta de bens a tua boca, de sorte que a tua mocidade se renova como a da águia –Salmo 103:1-5.

Jehoshaphat was in trouble. He had just heard the news that a great multitude was coming to fight against him. At that moment he did what all of us naturally do when a multitude of problems come against us. He was afraid. How well I know the feeling of fear, the dread that grips my heart at times. Sometimes it’s the big things, like being misunderstood and misused, or the fear and pain of sickness, or the death of a loved one. Sometimes it’s small things, like loneliness on a Sunday afternoon. This is not comfortable, God, and I’m afraid.

Jehoshaphat laid his fear aside, set himself to seek the Lord, and proclaimed a fast throughout all the land of Judah – verse 3. Even in this seemingly impossible situation of having thousands of men on their way to destroy him and his people, he fell before the Lord and acknowledged His perfect, omnipotent rule. And [he] said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee? –verse 6.

The choice is mine. I wrestle with my own fearful thoughts, turning them over and over in my mind as if hoping to change the situation with my messy and fearful concoctions. Clinging to my fear gives me a feeling of being in control. But it is killing me from the inside out, even without the dreaded “what ifs” becoming reality. Finally, I let go and fall exhausted at my Lord’s feet, and my heart echoes the words of Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah.

In humble entreaty, Jehoshaphat acknowledges their weakness and need for God’s power. O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee. –verse 12.

Yes, God, I am nothing in the grand scheme of things. I have no power, not even to be the fruitful worker in Your kingdom that I always dreamed of being. I can’t fight this battle.

Jehoshaphat realized that he alone, as one man, had no strength. He called all the people of Judah together, And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children –verse 13. They knew the strength in unity. As they stood before the Lord, waiting for Him to speak, the Spirit of the Lord came down and God gave them the words of help and hope that they were desperate for.

…Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s –verse 15. Often I try to fight my battles inside of myself rather than making myself vulnerable to others. But, as soon as I invite others into my life and into my battles, I find the strength of God through His people. When we are confused and disillusioned, we need the people of God. When we all pray together, we will get an answer to our prayer for direction.

Jehoshaphat heard the next directive from God. Tomorrow go ye down against them … Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD … fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you –verses 16-17. These words comfort my heart. Often the easiest thing to do is try to fix things, to quickly come up with a remedy of some sort to get myself out of this dilemma, to try to convince myself that everything will be okay. But God tells my heart to sit still without fear and let Him do the fighting. This takes more spiritual muscle than all the action, all the doing, and all the worrying; plus, it accomplishes a lot more.

And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD –verse 18. If I obey and trust instead of worry and sit still instead of jumping into the middle of things, then I will see God do miracles. No, not always in changing my circumstances or removing all the hard things, but He does a miracle in my own soul which changes my focus and attitude. And that causes me to worship because it’s a miracle which only the all-mighty, all-powerful God can do.

Do you think any of them slept that night? They knew a fearsome army was on its way to destroy them and yet… they had heard God speak. Just perhaps there was a joyful expectation in their hearts and an eager anticipation to see how God was going to win this battle. When I learn to practice trust in the little things and the big things that pile into my life, I will soon learn to have a heart of excited expectation, because I know He is going to do something! He is going to give me a way out. Even if the worst happens, He will show my heart the way of peace and He has promised to be with me through it all. And after all, the ultimate victory is already won, so what do all these infractions really have to do with my peace and joy? Nothing.

Morning dawned; it was the day God had told them to go out against these enemies. They arose with no delay. They all knew obedience was paramount in receiving God’s blessing that day. And as they went out of the city, Jehoshaphat exhorted them. And they rose early in the morning, …and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, …Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper. And… he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army… – verses 21-20. He appointed singers to sing as they went, proclaiming to everyone and to the opposing army that they were on the Lord’s side.

I would have liked to see that huge army going out of the city, singing. They were facing a daunting task and one that would have made the strongest man tremble, but they were singing. And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set… [an ambush] against the children of Ammon, [and] Moab, …which were come against Judah; and they were smitten …every one helped to destroy another –verses 22-23.

The people of Judah went to their watch tower and in amazement saw that their enemies had destroyed each other, and they saw nothing but an army of dead bodies. When a fearsome battle is set in array against me, I can still make the decision to trust and sing. Singing is a deliberate act of worship; it reminds our own souls and the souls of everyone listening that the Lord, He is God. He is the One in complete charge of my circumstances, of my tiny world, and all its problems. Suddenly the enemies are dead. The circumstances may not have changed, but the battle is finished in my soul.

The army of Judah spent the next three days gathering the riches and spoils from the dead bodies of their enemies, collecting so much that they couldn’t carry it all away with them. Astonishing! But that is how it is every time. My spirit benefits from the hard things that I endure successfully. Each victory allows me to collect ‘spoils’ which will profit me for the rest of my life. My heart is full of blessing, of being cared for, and being carried by a Heavenly Father. The “armies of Moab and Ammon” have brought blessing instead of ruin.

They came again to their homes in Jerusalem with singing, and harps, and trumpets, overloaded with all their spoil. The fear of God fell on all the kingdoms of the land when they heard how God had fought this huge battle, then Jehoshaphat’s realm was quiet. Peace reigned.

The peace of knowing that all I really need is God and His working in my life is the ultimate peace. This broken world can bring all manner of pain, sickness, and disappointments, but God brings rest to the heart that was once so full of tumult and fear. There is rest ‘round about’ and all the ‘kingdoms of the land’ will be amazed and curious at the strength that is within us, because it is the strength that no one can match—the strength of our amazing God.

Ο Ιωσαφάτ βρισκόταν σε δυσκολία. Μόλις άκουσε τα νέα ότι ένα μεγάλο πλήθος ερχόταν να πολεμήσει εναντίον του. Εκείνη τη στιγμή έκανε αυτό που όλοι μας φυσικά κάνουμε όταν ένα πλήθος προβλημάτων έρχεται εναντίον μας. Φοβήθηκε. Πόσο καλά γνωρίζω το αίσθημα του φόβου, τον τρόμο που σφίγγει την καρδιά μου κάποιες φορές. Μερικές φορές είναι τα μεγάλα πράγματα, όπως το να παρερμηνευτώ και να με καταχραστούν, ή ο φόβος και ο πόνος της αρρώστιας, ή ο θάνατος ενός αγαπημένου προσώπου. Μερικές φορές είναι μικρά πράγματα, όπως η μοναξιά ένα απόγευμα Κυριακής. Αυτό δεν είναι άνετο, Θεέ μου, και φοβάμαι.

Ο Ιωσαφάτ άφησε τον φόβο του, αποφάσισε να ζητήσει τον Κύριο και κήρυξε νηστεία σε όλη τη γη του Ιούδα – στίχος 3. Ακόμη και σε αυτήν την εμφανώς αδύνατη κατάσταση, με χιλιάδες άντρες να κατευθύνονται να τον καταστρέψουν αυτόν και τον λαό του, έπεσε μπροστά στον Κύριο και αναγνώρισε την τέλεια, παντοδύναμη κυριαρχία Του. Και είπε, Ω Κύριε, Θεέ των πατέρων ημών, δεν είσαι συ Θεός στον ουρανό; και δεν κυβερνάς σὺ όλα τα βασίλεια των εθνών; και δεν είναι στην χείρα σου δύναμις και ισχύς, ώστε να μην είναι κανείς δυνατός να σου αντισταθεί; – στίχος 6.

Η επιλογή είναι δική μου. Παλεύω με τις δικές μου φοβισμένες σκέψεις, γυρίζοντάς τες ξανά και ξανά στο μυαλό μου σαν να ελπίζω να αλλάξω την κατάσταση με τις ατακτοποίητες και φοβισμένες μου εφεύρεσεις. Το να σφίγγω τον φόβο μου μου δίνει ένα αίσθημα ελέγχου. Αλλά με σκοτώνει από μέσα, ακόμη και χωρίς τα φοβερά «τι θα γινόταν αν» να γίνουν πραγματικότητα. Τελικά, αφήνω και πέφτω εξαντλημένος στα πόδια του Κυρίου μου, και η καρδιά μου αντηχεί τα λόγια του Ιωσαφάτ, του βασιλιά του Ιούδα.

Με ταπεινή ικεσία, ο Ιωσαφάτ αναγνωρίζει την αδυναμία τους και την ανάγκη για τη δύναμη του Θεού. Ω Θεέ μας, θέλεις να μην κρίνεις αυτούς; διότι δεν έχουμε δύναμη εναντίον αυτού του μεγάλου όχλου που έρχεται κατά μας· ούτε ξέρουμε τι να κάνουμε· αλλά τα μάτια μας είναι σε σένα. – στίχος 12.

Ναι, Θεέ, δεν είμαι τίποτα στο μεγάλο σχέδιο των πραγμάτων. Δεν έχω δύναμη, ούτε καν να είμαι ο παραγωγικός εργάτης στη Βασιλεία Σου που πάντα ονειρευόμουν να είμαι. Δεν μπορώ να πολεμήσω αυτή τη μάχη.

Ο Ιωσαφάτ κατάλαβε ότι μόνος του, ως ένας άνθρωπος, δεν είχε δύναμη. Συγκέντρωσε όλον τον λαό του Ιούδα, Και όλος ο Ιούδας στάθηκε μπροστά στον Κύριο, με τα μικρά τους, τις γυναίκες τους και τα παιδιά τους – στίχος 13. Γνώριζαν τη δύναμη στην ενότητα. Καθώς στάθηκαν μπροστά στον Κύριο, περιμένοντας Αυτόν να μιλήσει, το Πνεύμα του Κυρίου κατέβηκε και ο Θεός τους έδωσε τα λόγια βοήθειας και ελπίδας που απεγνωσμένα χρειάζονταν.

…Μη φοβηθείτε και μη ταραχθείτε εξαιτίας αυτού του μεγάλου όχλου· διότι η μάχη δεν είναι δική σας, αλλά του Θεού – στίχος 15. Συχνά προσπαθώ να παλέψω τις μάχες μου μέσα μου αντί να κάνω τον εαυτό μου ευάλωτο σε άλλους. Αλλά μόλις προσκαλέσω άλλους στη ζωή μου και στις μάχες μου, βρίσκω τη δύναμη του Θεού μέσω του λαού Του. Όταν είμαστε μπερδεμένοι και απογοητευμένοι, χρειαζόμαστε τον λαό του Θεού. Όταν όλοι προσευχόμαστε μαζί, θα λάβουμε μια απάντηση στην προσευχή μας για κατεύθυνση.

Ο Ιωσαφάτ άκουσε την επόμενη οδηγία από τον Θεό. Αύριον καταβήτε εναντίον τους … Ουκ έξεσται υμίν να πολεμήσητε εν τη μάχη ταύτη· σταθήτε, και ίδετε την σωτηρίαν του Κυρίου … μη φοβηθείτε, μηδέ αποσταιθείτε· αύριον εκπορευθήσεσθε προς αυτούς· διότι ο Κύριος θέλει είναι μετά υμών – στίχοι 16-17. Αυτά τα λόγια παρηγορούν την καρδιά μου. Συχνά το πιο εύκολο είναι να προσπαθήσω να διορθώσω τα πράγματα, να βρω γρήγορα κάποια λύση για να βγω απ' αυτήν τη δυσκολία, να προσπαθήσω να πείσω τον εαυτό μου ότι όλα θα πάνε καλά. Αλλά ο Θεός λέει στην καρδιά μου να καθίσει ήσυχα χωρίς φόβο και να Τον αφήσει να κάνει τον αγώνα. Αυτό απαιτεί περισσότερους πνευματικούς μύες από όλη τη δράση, όλη τη δραστηριότητα και όλη τη ανησυχία· επίσης, επιτυγχάνει πολύ περισσότερα.

Και ο Ιωσαφάτ έγειρε το πρόσωπόν του στο έδαφος· και όλος ο Ιούδας και οι κάτοικοι των Ιερουσαλήμ έπεσαν μπροστά στον Κύριο, λατρεύοντες τον Κύριο – στίχος 18. Αν υπακούσω και εμπιστευθώ αντί να ανησυχώ και καθίσω ακίνητος αντί να ριχτώ στη μέση των πραγμάτων, τότε θα δω τον Θεό να κάνει θαύματα. Όχι, όχι πάντα αλλάζοντας τις περιστάσεις μου ή αφαιρώντας όλα τα δύσκολα, αλλά κάνει ένα θαύμα στην ψυχή μου που αλλάζει την εστίαση και τη στάση μου. Και αυτό με οδηγεί στη λατρεία επειδή είναι ένα θαύμα που μόνο ο παντοδύναμος, ο παντοκράτωρ μπορεί να κάνει.

Νομίζεις ότι κανείς απ' αυτούς κοιμήθηκε εκείνη τη νύχτα; Ήξεραν ότι ένας φοβερός στρατός ερχόταν να τους καταστρέψει και όμως… είχαν ακούσει τον Θεό να μιλά. Ίσως υπήρχε μια χαρούμενη προσδοκία στις καρδιές τους και μια ανυπόμονη αναμονή να δουν πώς ο Θεός θα κερδίσει αυτή τη μάχη. Όταν μάθω να εξασκώ την εμπιστοσύνη στα μικρά και στα μεγάλα πράγματα που σωρεύονται στη ζωή μου, σύντομα θα μάθω να έχω μια καρδιά γεμάτη ενθουσιώδη προσμονή, γιατί ξέρω ότι Αυτός θα κάνει κάτι! Θα μου δώσει διέξοδο. Ακόμη και αν συμβεί το χειρότερο, θα δείξει στην καρδιά μου τον δρόμο της ειρήνης και έχει υποσχεθεί να είναι μαζί μου σε όλα. Και, τελικά, η ύστατη νίκη έχει ήδη κερδηθεί, οπότε τι έχουν να κάνουν όλα αυτά τα επεισόδια με την ειρήνη και τη χαρά μου; Τίποτα.

Η αυγή ήρθε· ήταν η μέρα που ο Θεός τους είπε να βγουν εναντίον αυτών των εχθρών. Σηκώθηκαν χωρίς καθυστέρηση. Όλοι ήξεραν ότι η υπακοή ήταν πρωταρχική για να λάβουν την ευλογία του Θεού εκείνη την ημέρα. Και καθώς έβγαιναν από την πόλη, ο Ιωσαφάτ τους παρότρυνε. Και σηκώθηκαν νωρίς το πρωί, …και καθώς προχωρούσαν, ο Ιωσαφάτ στάθηκε και είπε, …Πιστεύετε στον Κύριον τον Θεόν σας, και θα σταθείτε· πιστεύετε στους προφήτες του, και θα ευοδωθήτε. Και… διόρισε ψαλμωδούς προς τον Κύριο, οι οποίοι θα υμνολογούσαν την ομορφιά της αγιότητας, καθώς προπορεύονταν του στρατού… – στίχοι 21-20. Διόρισε ψάλτες να ψάλλουν καθώς προχωρούσαν, διακηρύσσοντας σε όλους και στον αντιπάλων στρατό ότι ήταν με το μέρος του Κυρίου.

Θα ήθελα να δω εκείνον τον τεράστιο στρατό να βγαίνει από την πόλη, τραγουδώντας. Αντιμετώπιζαν ένα τρομακτικό έργο και ένα που θα έκανε τον πιο δυνατό άνδρα να τρέμει, αλλά τραγουδούσαν. Και όταν άρχισαν να ψάλλουν και να δοξολογούν, ο Κύριος έθεσε… [ενέδρα] κατά των παιδιών Αμμών και Μωάβ… που είχαν έρθει εναντίον του Ιούδα· και πατήθηκαν …ο ένας βοήθησε να καταστραφεί ο άλλος – στίχοι 22-23.

Ο λαός του Ιούδα ανέβηκε στον πύργο προσκοπής του και με θαυμασμό είδε ότι οι εχθροί του είχαν καταστρέψει ο ένας τον άλλο, και δεν είδαν τίποτε άλλο παρά έναν στρατό νεκρών σωμάτων. Όταν μια φοβερή μάχη στήνεται εναντίον μου, μπορώ ακόμα να πάρω την απόφαση να εμπιστευθώ και να τραγουδήσω. Το τραγούδι είναι μια σκόπιμη πράξη λατρείας· υπενθυμίζει στην ίδια μας την ψυχή και στις ψυχές όλων όσων ακούν ότι ο Κύριος, Αυτός είναι ο Θεός. Αυτός είναι ο Ελεγκτής των περιστάσεών μου, του μικρού μου κόσμου και όλων των προβλημάτων του. Ξαφνικά οι εχθροί είναι νεκροί. Οι περιστάσεις μπορεί να μην έχουν αλλάξει, αλλά η μάχη τελείωσε στην ψυχή μου.

Ο στρατός του Ιούδα πέρασε τις επόμενες τρεις μέρες συγκεντρώνοντας πλούτη και λάφυρα από τα νεκρά σώματα των εχθρών τους, μαζεύοντας τόσο πολύ που δεν μπορούσαν να το κουβαλήσουν όλο μαζί τους. Εκπληκτικό! Αλλά έτσι είναι κάθε φορά. Το πνεύμα μου ωφελείται από τα δύσκολα που αντέχω επιτυχώς. Κάθε νίκη μου επιτρέπει να συγκεντρώσω «λάφυρα» που θα με ωφελήσουν για την υπόλοιπη ζωή μου. Η καρδιά μου είναι γεμάτη ευλογία, με το να με φροντίζει και να με κουβαλά Πατέρας Ουράνιος. Οι “στρατοί των Μωάβ και Αμμών” έφεραν ευλογία αντί για καταστροφή.

Επέστρεψαν στα σπίτια τους στην Ιερουσαλήμ με τραγούδι, με άρπες και σάλπιγγες, φορτωμένοι με όλα τα λάφυρά τους. Ο φόβος του Θεού έπεσε σε όλα τα βασίλεια της γης όταν άκουσαν πώς ο Θεός είχε πολεμήσει αυτήν την τεράστια μάχη, και τότε η βασιλεία του Ιωσαφάτ ήταν ήσυχη. Επέβαλε ειρήνη.

Η ειρήνη του να ξέρεις ότι το μόνο που πραγματικά χρειάζομαι είναι ο Θεός και το έργο Του στη ζωή μου είναι η υπέρτατη ειρήνη. Αυτός ο σπασμένος κόσμος μπορεί να φέρει κάθε είδους πόνο, αρρώστια και απογοητεύσεις, αλλά ο Θεός φέρνει ανάπαυση στην καρδιά που κάποτε ήταν τόσο γεμάτη αναταραχή και φόβο. Υπάρχει ανάπαυση «περίξ» και όλα τα «βασίλεια της γης» θα είναι θαυμασμένα και περίεργα για τη δύναμη που είναι μέσα μας, επειδή είναι η δύναμη που κανείς δεν μπορεί να ανταγωνιστεί—η δύναμη του θαυμαστού Θεού μας.
