The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, To preach the acceptable year of the Lord –Luke 4:18-19.

Jesus was in His hometown of Nazareth. It was on the Sabbath, and He stood to read the scripture as He had in the past. This Sabbath He read from Isaiah 61. When He finished, He said, …This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears –Luke 4:21.

This marked the beginning of Jesus’ earthly ministry. In this first sermon He described the nature of His ministry. Notice the many references in this passage to healing: healing to the brokenhearted, deliverance to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, and liberty to the bruised. Jesus came to provide a remedy for our brokenness. He came to repair the damage that sin has brought into humanity.

In this article we will look at the possibility for healing that is found in Jesus. Healing is a process that requires inner restoration with outside remediation. Physical healing begins at the cellular level and restores physical function. Spiritual healing begins at the heart level and restores us to fullness of life. Jesus said, …I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly – John 10:10.

As Jesus walked the dusty paths of Judea, He encountered many who needed physical healing. It was His ability to heal that drew many to seek Him out and to follow him. Many brought their friends and family to Him for healing. There is in all of us a desire for healing and wholeness. In the garden of Eden, mankind was created to be whole. When we are not whole, we seek every possible cure. So, crowds gathered around Jesus hoping for healing.

One day as Jesus was journeying through Jericho, a blind man, Bartimaeus, heard that He was approaching. Hope sprang up in his breast. He began to call out to Jesus, “Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.” They tried to silence him, but he called the louder, “Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.”

He cast his coat aside and blindly rushed into the street. Jesus said to him, “What wilt thou that I should do unto thee?” He said, “Lord, that I might receive my sight.” Jesus’ response to this simple faith was, “Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole.” Immediately, he received his sight, and followed Jesus. This is just one example of Jesus’ healing ministry. The examples are many. He healed lepers. He healed paralytics. He healed men and women of unclean spirits.

Does Jesus still heal in our day? I would like to answer that question by sharing my own journey of healing. I realize that not all are healed. Even in Jesus’ day, not all were healed. But I want to share my journey of healing to demonstrate the interconnectedness of the physical and the spiritual.

I was diagnosed with cancer in May of 2020. Hearing a doctor say, “You have millions of cancer cells in your body”, brought me face to face with my mortality like never before. Oh, I knew that someday I would die, but that was always somewhere in the far distant future. Now I needed to face the fact that I had a disease growing within me which had the potential to destroy my body.

Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him. Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much –James 5:14-16.

I have always been a strong advocate of anointing with oil. Just like we are taught in the book of James, I called for the elders of the church and asked them to anoint me with oil. In the biblical teaching of God healing through the anointing with oil there are a number of things that are expected of those seeking the healing. There is: call[ing] for the elders of the church, the prayer of faith, pray[ing] one for another, Confess[ing] your faults one to another, the effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man… and the list goes on. So, one of the necessities to seek healing through the anointing with oil is the clearing of the heart of any known, unconfessed sin. Hence, I searched my heart and cleansed my heart of anything that would hinder God’s healing of my body.

Notice the close correlation in this passage between the physical and the spiritual. I found in my journey of healing that the one affects the other. Physical healing begins with spiritual healing. A few drops of oil have no therapeutic benefit. This anointing with oil is primarily a spiritual exercise. If we practice this ordinance as James offered it, we cleanse our hearts inwardly and then we ask God for physical healing.

This was my first step to healing, but a long journey lay ahead. We consulted with multiple doctors and eventually we chose a treatment protocol that included radiation and hormone therapy. This treatment weakened me physically and made me feel my humanity. It made me more dependent on God and others and less confident in my own abilities. Living with weakness caused me to draw my strength from my Heavenly Father Who is the source of strength. I relied heavily on the encouragement and support that my wife and family offered.

There are some lessons that can only be learned through human weakness. It was for this reason that Paul was given a thorn in the flesh. He sought the Lord three times for healing. God’s answer came back always the same, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my strength is made perfect in your weakness.” I can testify that that is true.

I had multiple radiation treatments in January of 2021. I had scheduled a series of meetings for the month of February thinking that my treatments would be over, and I would be back to normal. What I did not realize was the delayed effect of radiation. I breezed through the treatments, but in February I experienced a lot of digestive issues and a lot of physical weakness.

I was expected to deliver a series of four sermons on four consecutive evenings. We prayed and although I could not get through the day without napping God provided supernatural strength for those evening messages. I praise God that His strength was made perfect in my weakness.

My doctors have plied their trade. I am grateful for the professional medical care that I received. I have done what I could with herbs and supplements and God has been merciful. My last bloodwork came back “undetectable”. May God be praised!

I am sharing my experience to show the correlation between the physical and the spiritual. Physical illness in my experience had a sanctifying effect on my spirit and spiritual renewal conditioned my body for healing. I will be forever grateful for the professional care given by my doctors, but even they realize the limits of their profession. On my last visit to my Medical Oncologist, he said to me, “Now we are going to trust the Lord.” Thank God for God-fearing doctors!

There are several examples in scripture that demonstrate this correlation between physical and spiritual healing. In Mark 2 when they let the paralytic down through the roof into the presence of Jesus, He said to the paralytic, “Thy sins be forgiven thee.” Then He said, “Rise up and walk.” When He was challenged by the Pharisees for forgiving sins, He said to them, “Which is easier to say rise up and walk or thy sins be forgiven”, demonstrating that He had the power to do both. If we believe that Jesus has the power to forgive our sins, do we also believe that He has the power to heal our bodies? I do!

In John 5, Jesus healed a man who lay by the pool of Bethesda. He had this infirmity for thirty-eight years. Jesus came by and healed him. Later when He met him in the temple He said to him, “Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.” Note the correlation between the physical and the spiritual.

Physical infirmity has a tremendous potential to open our hearts to spiritual realities if we allow it to. The Psalmist said: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word –Psalm 119:67. Jesus said: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, To preach the acceptable year of the Lord –Luke 4:18-19.

Take a fresh look at our proof text for this article and notice that Jesus is offering more than physical healing. He promises healing to the brokenhearted, deliverance to the captives, and liberty to the bruised. These promises are of emotional healing—healing for the hurt that we receive as a result of living in a broken, sin-cursed world.

I am sure that there are many people reading this article who have experienced trauma that I know nothing about. But I want to assure you that you can be healed. Do you believe that? Do you believe that the pain can go away? Do you believe that you can be delivered from fear, anxiety, anger, and bitterness?

We addressed the correlation between spiritual and physical healing. There is also a correlation between spiritual and emotional healing. If you are experiencing a broken heart, Jesus wants to heal your broken heart. If you are a captive—if you are bound to a past or to an addiction that prevents your freedom—Jesus will set you free. If you have been bruised Jesus will heal you.

My wife and I are appalled at the large number of people in our Anabaptist churches that are turning to psych drugs (mind medication) and secular counseling to find solutions for emotional disorders. The Bible addresses most emotional disorders:

Fear

  • There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear –1 John 4:18.
  • What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee –Psalm 56:3.
  • “Fear not” is found 63 times in the Bible

Anxiety

  • Be careful [anxious] for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God –Philippians 4:6.

Anger

  • Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice –Ephesians 4:31.

This is just a sampling of emotional disorders that we encounter in life, and I realize that behind these emotions there is often deep-seated trauma. Your trauma is not an astonishment to Jesus. He may not have experienced your exact trauma, but he has gone to the depth of your pain, and he has come through it in victory.

For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin. Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need –Hebrews 4:15-16.

The gospel provides a holistic remedy to man’s sin problem. Our Anabaptist heritage has emphasized the fact that faith in Jesus affects every area of our lives. This faith motivates us to follow Jesus in very practical ways in our daily lives. This results in a life of radical nonconformity to the world around us.

This radical discipleship should also affect our emotional responses to difficult people and circumstances. Or have we become so emotionally fragile that if life does not give us exactly what we want it upsets our emotional equilibrium? Or maybe the gospel that we preach has become a litany of words that appeases the mind but has no effect on our soul.

Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it. For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it –Hebrews 4:1-2. Is our faith in God so weak (remember that in the Biblical accounts of healing, it was their faith that enabled the healing) that we have more faith in medication or in a board-certified secular counselor than we have in God and His Word?

This is a discipleship series. Come with me to the mountain where Jesus is teaching. Yes, there is a large crowd, but follow me closely, we will try to get close enough to hear. I hear His voice—He is saying something about “salt of the earth” and “light of the world.” Here is an empty space—just room for two. Let’s sit on the grass and listen:

“Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also. And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain. Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy. But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you; That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.”

These are radical teachings. Radical in that they are so opposite from our natural inclinations, and yet, this is the way of peace. Most of our negative emotions such as anger, fear, and anxiety can be remedied by applying these teachings of Jesus to our situations. This may sound overly simplistic, but that is the nature of the gospel and millions of people have found life and freedom through faith in Christ.

Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases; Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies; Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s –Psalm 103:1-5.

Roh Tuhan ada pada-Ku, oleh sebab Ia telah mengurapi Aku untuk memberitakan kabar baik kepada orang-orang miskin; Ia telah mengutus Aku untuk menyembuhkan orang-orang yang patah hati, untuk memberitakan pembebasan kepada orang-orang tawanan, dan pemulihan penglihatan kepada orang-orang buta, untuk membebaskan orang-orang yang teraniaya, untuk memberitakan tahun rahmat dari Tuhan – Lukas 4:18-19.

Yesus berada di kampung halamannya, Nazaret. Waktu itu hari Sabat, dan Ia berdiri untuk membaca Kitab Suci seperti yang pernah Ia lakukan. Sabat itu Ia membaca dari Yesaya 61. Setelah Ia selesai, Ia berkata, …Pada hari ini genaplah nas ini pada telinga-telinga kamu – Lukas 4:21.

Ini menandai permulaan pelayanan Yesus di dunia. Dalam khotbah pertamanya Ia menggambarkan hakikat pelayanan-Nya. Perhatikan banyak rujukan dalam bagian ini terhadap penyembuhan: penyembuhan bagi yang patah hati, pembebasan bagi tawanan, pemulihan penglihatan bagi yang buta, dan pembebasan bagi yang teraniaya. Yesus datang untuk menyediakan obat bagi kerapuhan kita. Ia datang untuk memperbaiki kerusakan yang dibawa dosa ke dalam umat manusia.

Dalam artikel ini kita akan melihat kemungkinan penyembuhan yang terdapat dalam Yesus. Penyembuhan adalah suatu proses yang memerlukan pemulihan batin disertai perbaikan dari luar. Penyembuhan fisik dimulai pada tingkat seluler dan mengembalikan fungsi fisik. Penyembuhan rohani dimulai di tingkat hati dan mengembalikan kita kepada kepenuhan hidup. Yesus berkata, …Aku datang supaya mereka mempunyai hidup, dan supaya mereka mempunyainya dalam segala kelimpahan – Yohanes 10:10.

Saat Yesus berjalan di jalan-jalan berdebu Yudea, Ia bertemu banyak orang yang membutuhkan penyembuhan fisik. Kemampuan-Nya untuk menyembuhkan menarik banyak orang datang kepada-Nya dan mengikut Dia. Banyak orang membawa teman dan keluarga mereka kepada-Nya untuk disembuhkan. Dalam diri kita semua ada kerinduan akan pemulihan dan keseluruhan. Di taman Eden, manusia diciptakan untuk menjadi utuh. Ketika kita tidak utuh, kita mencari segala obat yang mungkin. Maka, orang banyak berkumpul di sekitar Yesus dengan harapan disembuhkan.

Suatu hari ketika Yesus sedang lewat di Yerikho, seorang buta, Bartimeus, mendengar bahwa Ia mendekat. Harapan muncul dalam dadanya. Ia mulai memanggil Yesus, “Yesus, hai anak Daud, kasihanilah aku.” Mereka berusaha membuatnya diam, tetapi ia berseru semakin keras, “Yesus, hai anak Daud, kasihanilah aku.”

Ia melempar jubahnya dan dengan membabi buta berlari ke jalan. Yesus berkata kepadanya, “Apa yang kau kehendaki supaya Aku perbuat bagimu?” Ia berkata, “Tuhan, supaya aku dapat melihat.” Tanggapan Yesus terhadap iman yang sederhana itu adalah, “Pergilah, imanmu telah menyelamatkan engkau.” Seketika itu juga ia menerima penglihatannya, dan mengikuti Yesus. Ini hanyalah satu contoh dari pelayanan penyembuhan Yesus. Contohnya banyak. Ia menyembuhkan kusta. Ia menyembuhkan orang lumpuh. Ia menyembuhkan laki-laki dan perempuan yang kerasukan roh jahat.

Apakah Yesus masih menyembuhkan pada zaman kita? Saya ingin menjawab pertanyaan itu dengan membagikan perjalanan penyembuhan saya sendiri. Saya menyadari bahwa tidak semua orang disembuhkan. Bahkan pada zaman Yesus, tidak semua orang disembuhkan. Tetapi saya ingin berbagi perjalanan penyembuhan saya untuk menunjukkan keterkaitan antara yang fisik dan yang rohani.

Saya didiagnosis menderita kanker pada Mei 2020. Mendengar seorang dokter berkata, “Anda memiliki jutaan sel kanker di tubuh Anda”, membuat saya berhadapan langsung dengan kefanaan saya seperti belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya. Oh, saya tahu bahwa suatu hari saya akan mati, tetapi itu selalu terasa jauh di masa depan. Sekarang saya harus menghadapi kenyataan bahwa ada penyakit tumbuh dalam diri saya yang berpotensi menghancurkan tubuh saya.

Adakah di antara kamu yang sakit? Hendaklah ia memanggil penatua-penatua jemaat, dan hendaklah mereka mendoakan dia dan mengurapinya dengan minyak dalam nama Tuhan; dan doa iman akan menyelamatkan orang yang sakit, dan Tuhan akan membangunkannya; dan jika ia telah berbuat dosa, maka ia akan diampuni. Hendaklah kamu saling mengaku dosamu seorang kepada yang lain, dan hendaklah kamu saling mendoakan, supaya kamu sembuh. Doa orang benar, apabila dengan yakin didoakan, besar kuasanya – Yakobus 5:14-16.

Saya selalu menjadi pendukung kuat pengurapan dengan minyak. Sama seperti yang diajarkan dalam kitab Yakobus, saya memanggil penatua-penatua jemaat dan meminta mereka mengurapi saya dengan minyak. Dalam ajaran alkitabiah tentang Allah menyembuhkan melalui pengurapan dengan minyak terdapat sejumlah hal yang diharapkan dari mereka yang mencari penyembuhan. Ada: memanggil penatua jemaat, doa iman, saling mendoakan, saling mengaku kesalahan satu kepada yang lain, doa orang benar yang bersemangat yang manjur… dan daftar itu berlanjut. Jadi, salah satu kebutuhan untuk mencari penyembuhan melalui pengurapan dengan minyak adalah pembersihan hati dari dosa yang diketahui dan tidak diakui. Karena itu, saya menelaah hati saya dan membersihkan hati saya dari apa pun yang akan menghalangi penyembuhan tubuh saya oleh Allah.

Perhatikan korelasi erat dalam bagian ini antara yang fisik dan yang rohani. Saya mendapati dalam perjalanan penyembuhan saya bahwa yang satu memengaruhi yang lain. Penyembuhan fisik dimulai dengan penyembuhan rohani. Beberapa tetes minyak tidak memiliki manfaat terapeutik. Pengurapan dengan minyak ini terutama merupakan latihan rohani. Jika kita melaksanakan aturan ini sebagaimana yang ditawarkan Yakobus, kita membersihkan hati kita dari dalam dan kemudian kita meminta Allah untuk penyembuhan fisik.

Ini adalah langkah pertama saya menuju penyembuhan, tetapi perjalanan panjang masih menanti. Kami berkonsultasi dengan beberapa dokter dan akhirnya kami memilih protokol pengobatan yang mencakup radiasi dan terapi hormon. Perawatan ini melemahkan saya secara fisik dan membuat saya merasakan kemanusiaan saya. Itu membuat saya lebih bergantung pada Allah dan orang lain serta kurang percaya diri pada kemampuan sendiri. Hidup dalam kelemahan menyebabkan saya menarik kekuatan dari Bapa Surgawi saya yang adalah sumber kekuatan. Saya sangat bergantung pada dorongan dan dukungan yang diberikan istri dan keluarga saya.

Ada beberapa pelajaran yang hanya dapat dipelajari melalui kelemahan manusia. Karena alasan inilah Paulus diberi duri dalam daging. Ia memohon kepada Tuhan tiga kali untuk kesembuhan. Jawaban Allah selalu sama, “Kasih karunia-Ku cukup bagimu, sebab kekuatan-Ku menjadi sempurna dalam kelemahan.” Saya dapat memberi kesaksian bahwa itu benar.

Saya menerima beberapa kali perawatan radiasi pada Januari 2021. Saya telah menjadwalkan serangkaian pertemuan untuk bulan Februari dengan pikiran bahwa perawatan saya akan selesai, dan saya akan kembali normal. Yang tidak saya sadari adalah efek tertunda dari radiasi. Saya melewati perawatan itu dengan cukup baik, tetapi pada Februari saya mengalami banyak masalah pencernaan dan kelemahan fisik yang besar.

Saya diharapkan menyampaikan serangkaian empat khotbah dalam empat malam berturut-turut. Kami berdoa dan meskipun saya tidak bisa melewati hari tanpa tidur siang, Allah menyediakan kekuatan supranatural untuk pesan-pesan malam itu. Saya memuji Allah bahwa kekuatan-Nya menjadi sempurna dalam kelemahan saya.

Dokter-dokter saya telah menjalankan keahlian mereka. Saya bersyukur atas perawatan medis profesional yang saya terima. Saya telah melakukan apa yang saya bisa dengan ramuan dan suplemen dan Allah telah berbelas kasihan. Hasil darah terakhir saya kembali “tidak terdeteksi”. Terpujilah Allah!

Saya membagikan pengalaman saya untuk menunjukkan korelasi antara yang fisik dan yang rohani. Penyakit fisik dalam pengalaman saya memiliki efek menguduskan pada roh saya dan pembaruan rohani mempersiapkan tubuh saya untuk penyembuhan. Saya akan selamanya berterima kasih atas perawatan profesional yang diberikan oleh dokter-dokter saya, tetapi mereka pun menyadari keterbatasan profesi mereka. Pada kunjungan terakhir saya ke Onkologis Medik saya, ia berkata kepada saya, “Sekarang kita akan percaya kepada Tuhan.” Syukurlah untuk dokter yang takut akan Allah!

Ada beberapa contoh dalam Kitab Suci yang menunjukkan korelasi ini antara penyembuhan fisik dan rohani. Dalam Markus 2 ketika mereka menurunkan orang lumpuh melalui atap ke hadapan Yesus, Ia berkata kepada orang lumpuh itu, “Hai anak, dosamu diampuni.” Lalu Ia berkata, “Bangunlah, angkatlah tempat tidurmu dan pulanglah ke rumahmu.” Ketika Dia ditantang oleh orang-orang Farisi karena mengampuni dosa, Ia berkata kepada mereka, “Manakah yang lebih mudah untuk diucapkan: dosamu diampuni atau bangunlah dan berjalanlah?”, menunjukkan bahwa Ia mempunyai kuasa untuk melakukan kedua-duanya. Jika kita percaya bahwa Yesus mempunyai kuasa untuk mengampuni dosa kita, apakah kita juga percaya bahwa Ia mempunyai kuasa untuk menyembuhkan tubuh kita? Saya percaya!

Dalam Yohanes 5, Yesus menyembuhkan seorang yang terbaring di kolam Betesda. Ia telah menderita penyakit itu selama tiga puluh delapan tahun. Yesus datang dan menyembuhkannya. Nanti ketika Ia bertemu dengannya di bait Allah Ia berkata kepadanya, “Lihatlah, engkau telah menjadi sembuh: jangan berbuat dosa lagi, supaya jangan keadaan yang lebih buruk menimpa engkau.” Perhatikan korelasi antara yang fisik dan yang rohani.

Kelemahan fisik memiliki potensi besar untuk membuka hati kita kepada realitas rohani jika kita mengizinkannya. Pemazmur berkata: Sebelum aku menderita, aku sesat: tetapi sekarang aku berpegang pada perkataan-Mu – Mazmur 119:67. Yesus berkata: Roh Tuhan ada pada-Ku, oleh sebab Ia telah mengurapi Aku untuk memberitakan kabar baik kepada orang-orang miskin; Ia telah mengutus Aku untuk menyembuhkan orang-orang yang patah hati, untuk memberitakan pembebasan kepada orang-orang tawanan, dan pemulihan penglihatan kepada orang-orang buta, untuk membebaskan orang-orang yang teraniaya, untuk memberitakan tahun rahmat dari Tuhan – Lukas 4:18-19.

Lihat kembali teks sandaran kita untuk artikel ini dan perhatikan bahwa Yesus menawarkan lebih dari sekadar penyembuhan fisik. Ia menjanjikan penyembuhan bagi yang patah hati, pembebasan bagi tawanan, dan pembebasan bagi yang teraniaya. Janji-janji ini adalah penyembuhan emosional—penyembuhan untuk luka yang kita terima sebagai akibat hidup di dunia yang rusak dan terkutuk oleh dosa.

Saya yakin banyak orang yang membaca artikel ini telah mengalami trauma yang tidak saya ketahui. Tetapi saya ingin meyakinkan Anda bahwa Anda dapat disembuhkan. Apakah Anda percaya itu? Apakah Anda percaya bahwa rasa sakit itu bisa hilang? Apakah Anda percaya bahwa Anda dapat dibebaskan dari ketakutan, kecemasan, amarah, dan kepahitan?

Kita telah membahas korelasi antara penyembuhan rohani dan fisik. Ada juga korelasi antara penyembuhan rohani dan emosional. Jika Anda mengalami hati yang hancur, Yesus ingin menyembuhkan hati Anda yang hancur. Jika Anda seorang tawanan—jika Anda terikat pada masa lalu atau pada kecanduan yang mencegah kebebasan Anda—Yesus akan memerdekakan Anda. Jika Anda telah terluka, Yesus akan menyembuhkan Anda.

Istri saya dan saya tercengang melihat banyaknya orang di gereja-gereja Anabaptis kami yang beralih ke obat psikiatri (obat pikiran) dan konseling sekuler untuk mencari solusi bagi gangguan emosional. Alkitab membahas sebagian besar gangguan emosional:

Ketakutan

  • Dalam kasih tidak ada ketakutan; tetapi kasih yang sempurna melenyapkan ketakutan – 1 Yohanes 4:18.
  • Di waktu aku takut, aku percaya kepada-Mu – Mazmur 56:3.
  • “Jangan takut” ditemukan 63 kali dalam Alkitab

Kecemasan

  • Janganlah hendaknya kamu khawatir tentang apapun; tetapi dalam segala hal dengan doa dan permohonan serta ucapan syukur, nyatakanlah keinginanmu kepada Allah – Filipi 4:6.

Amarah

  • Buanglah jauh-jauh dari hatimu segala kepahitan, dan kemarahan, dan murka, dan pertengkaran, dan fitnah, bersama segala kejahatan – Efesus 4:31.

Ini hanyalah contoh sampel gangguan emosional yang kita temui dalam hidup, dan saya menyadari bahwa di balik emosi-emosi ini seringkali ada trauma yang berakar dalam. Traumamu bukanlah sesuatu yang mengherankan bagi Yesus. Ia mungkin tidak mengalami trauma persis yang kau alami, tetapi Ia telah menjelajahi kedalaman rasa sakitmu, dan Ia telah melaluinya dalam kemenangan.

Sebab kita tidak mempunyai Imam Besar yang tidak dapat turut merasakan kelemahan-kelemahan kita, melainkan yang telah dicobai dalam segala sesuatu sama seperti kita, tetapi tidak berbuat dosa. Oleh sebab itu marilah kita dengan penuh keberanian menghampiri takhta kasih karunia, supaya kita memperoleh rahmat dan menemukan anugerah untuk mendapat pertolongan pada waktunya – Ibrani 4:15-16.

Injil menyediakan obat yang menyeluruh bagi masalah dosa manusia. Warisan Anabaptis kita menekankan fakta bahwa iman kepada Yesus memengaruhi setiap bidang hidup kita. Iman ini memotivasi kita untuk mengikuti Yesus dalam cara-cara yang sangat praktis dalam kehidupan sehari-hari kita. Ini menghasilkan hidup yang radikal tidak meniru dunia di sekitar kita.

Pengajaran murid yang radikal ini seharusnya juga memengaruhi respons emosional kita terhadap orang-orang dan keadaan yang sulit. Ataukah kita menjadi begitu rapuh secara emosional sehingga jika hidup tidak memberi kita persis apa yang kita inginkan, itu mengganggu keseimbangan emosional kita? Atau mungkin injil yang kita khotbahkan telah menjadi rangkaian kata-kata yang menenangkan pikiran tetapi tidak membawa pengaruh kepada jiwa kita.

Karena itu marilah kita takut, supaya jangan, ketika janji tentang masuk ke dalam tempat istirahat-Nya masih tetap, ada di antara kamu yang kelihatan tidak mencapai itu. Karena kepada kita telah diberitakan kabar baik sama seperti kepada mereka juga: tetapi firman yang didengarkan tidak memberi keuntungan kepada mereka, karena tidak disertai iman pada mereka yang mendengarnya – Ibrani 4:1-2. Apakah iman kita kepada Allah begitu lemah (ingat bahwa dalam catatan alkitabiah tentang penyembuhan, iman merekalah yang memungkinkan penyembuhan) sehingga kita lebih percaya pada obat-obatan atau pada konselor sekuler bersertifikat daripada pada Allah dan Firman-Nya?

Ini adalah sebuah seri pemuridan. Ikutlah dengan saya ke gunung tempat Yesus mengajar. Ya, ada kerumunan besar, tetapi ikutlah dengan seksama, kita akan mencoba mendekat cukup untuk mendengar. Aku mendengar suara-Nya—Ia sedang mengatakan sesuatu tentang “garam dunia” dan “terang dunia.” Ini ada tempat kosong—hanya ada ruang untuk dua orang. Mari kita duduk di rerumputan dan mendengarkan:

“Kamu telah mendengar bahwa disebutkan: Mata ganti mata dan gigi ganti gigi. Tetapi Aku berkata kepadamu: janganlah kamu melawan orang yang berbuat jahat kepadamu; bahkan siapa saja yang menampar pipimu yang kanan, berikanlah juga kepadanya pipi yang lain.

Dan barangsiapa menuntut engkau di pengadilan untuk mengambil bajumu, serahkanlah juga jubahmu. Dan barangsiapa memaksa engkau berjalan sejauh satu mil, berjalanlah bersama dia sejauh dua mil. Berilah kepada orang yang meminta kepadamu, dan janganlah menolak orang yang mau meminjam dari padamu.

Kamu telah mendengar bahwa disebutkan: Kasihilah sesamamu dan bencilah musuhmu. Tetapi Aku berkata kepadamu: Kasihilah musuhmu, berkatilah orang-orang yang mengutuk kamu, berbuatlah baiklah kepada orang-orang yang membenci kamu dan doakanlah orang-orang yang menganiaya kamu dan yang menghasut kamu; supaya kamu menjadi anak-anak Bapamu yang di sorga: sebab Ia menerbitkan matahari-Nya bagi orang yang jahat dan bagi orang yang baik dan menurunkan hujan bagi orang yang saleh dan orang yang tidak saleh.”

Ini adalah ajaran yang radikal. Radikal karena mereka bertentangan total dengan kecenderungan alami kita, namun inilah jalan damai. Sebagian besar emosi negatif kita seperti amarah, ketakutan, dan kecemasan dapat diatasi dengan menerapkan pengajaran Yesus ini pada situasi kita. Ini mungkin terdengar terlalu sederhana, tetapi demikianlah hakikat injil dan jutaan orang telah menemukan hidup dan kebebasan melalui iman kepada Kristus.

Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku, dan segala yang ada di dalam aku, pujilah nama-Nya yang kudus. Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku, dan janganlah lupakan segala kebaikan-Nya: yang mengampuni segala kesalahanmu; yang menyembuhkan segala penyakitmu; yang melepaskan hidupmu dari kebinasaan; yang menghiasi engkau dengan kasih setia dan belas kasihan; yang memuaskan hidupmu dengan kebaikan, sehingga masa mudamu menjadi baru seperti rajawali – Mazmur 103:1-5.

Lunchtime was over and it was that delightful hour of the day when mom said it was time for a break. Since Ellie was ten, she wasn’t required to take a daily nap anymore, so she set about trying to decide just how she would spend this free time. She loved being outdoors, so the sunny skies and fresh air of this particularly lovely summer day fairly pulled her outside.

“I know!” she thought to herself. “This would be a perfect time to try some whittling with that knife Paul gave me.”

She had spent a week with her aunt and uncle who lived several counties over from hers and while there, her cousin Paul had given her a knife that he had made. It had a short, round handle and he had inserted a small piece of steel into one end. He then honed the blade to a nice sharp edge. He could carve the funniest little faces on small blocks of wood and Ellie was always eager to see what he would create next. She tried to copy him, but it didn’t seem as if she would be turning out anything very exciting any time soon. Still, it was fun to try, so she got the knife from her drawer in her bedroom and headed outside.

The large maple tree in front of their old stone farmhouse beckoned to her. Its low hanging branches seemed like the perfect place to perch and try out that knife again. Ellie selected a few large twigs and then hoisted herself up into the cool shade of the tree. Once situated, she began cutting and picking away at her pieces of wood. She still couldn’t make eyes and a nose appear, but she had fun carving notches and shaving off small pieces of bark. It was a relaxing thing with which to be occupied while enjoying the quietness of the afternoon. She was so glad this tree was in their yard, and she was so glad that Paul had given her that whittling knife.

After a time, the branch Ellie was sitting on began to feel rough and hard, and the twigs she was whittling had nearly disappeared. “I should go see what the boys are doing,” she thought. She shifted to the lowest branch and sat poised, ready to jump down like she always did to get out of the tree.

She paused, looking at the knife in her hand. “Never jump down from anywhere while holding a knife in your hand!” her mother’s voice rang in her memory. “It is a very dangerous thing to do. You could get cut very badly.” Ellie sat thinking about that for a little.

“Yes, I know that’s probably true,” she told herself. “But I think if I am very careful, I could jump down and it will be fine,” she reasoned.

She firmly grasped the knife in her right hand, then quickly jumped the distance to the ground. Just as she landed, her ankle turned and gave way under her. She fell awkwardly onto her left leg. And, oh no! That little knife had plunged into her left wrist as she was trying to keep her balance. She quickly pulled it out and watched, with her heart beating rapidly, as the blood welled up, dark and warm. It was a small cut, only about one quarter of an inch long, but it had gone in rather deeply.

What should she do now? Yes, there was no doubt about it, her mom had been right after all! In her heart, she knew the right thing to do would be to go directly to her mother and tell her what she had done. But she felt guilty and ashamed. She had known better than to jump down with that knife, yet she had gone ahead and done it anyway. Guiltily, she quickly pressed her thumb on top of the wound and slipped into the house. The bleeding soon stopped, and after finding a little bandage and placing it on her cut, she quietly put her knife away and found a book to read. She never told her mom what she had done until many years later when she was a grown woman.

Today, as she looks at that scar, which is still visible from 40 years ago, she wonders why God had protected her. She had been a foolish little girl to not go immediately to her mother and confess what she had done. She could have gotten a severe infection from getting cut with a dirty, slightly rusty knife. Even though she acted foolishly, she is grateful that God protected her, but she still wishes she had confessed her disobedience to her mother.

It is never wise to hide anything from your parents. They need to know those wrong things you do, no matter how embarrassed or ashamed you might feel. Parents need to know all the things that happen to their children It is God’s design for fathers and mothers to be there for their children, to help you when you get hurt, and to guide and teach you as you learn how to be good, obedient children. God’s way is always the best.

دوپہر کا کھانا ختم ہو چکا تھا اور وہ خوشگوار گھڑی آ گئی تھی جب ماں نے کہا کہ اب آرام کرنے کا وقت ہے۔ چونکہ ایلی دس سال کی تھی، اس لیے اب روزانہ کی نیند لازمی نہیں رہی تھی، اس لیے وہ سوچنے لگی کہ وہ اس فارغ وقت کو کس طرح گزارے گی۔ اسے باہر رہنا پسند تھا، اسی لیے اس خاص خوبصورت گرمیوں کے دن کی دھوپ اور تازہ ہوا نے اسے باہر کھینچ لیا۔

“مجھے پتا ہے!” اُس نے اپنے آپ سے سوچا۔ “یہ پل وہ بہترین وقت ہوگا جب میں اس چھری سے تراش خراش کرنے کی کوشش کروں جو پال نے مجھے دی تھی۔”

وہ ایک ہفتہ اپنی پھوپھی اور چچا کے ہاں رہی تھی جو اس کے ضلع سے کچھ دور رہتے تھے اور وہاں اس کا کزن پال نے اسے ایک چھری دی تھی جو اس نے خود بنائی تھی۔ اس کا ہینڈل چھوٹا اور گول تھا اور اُس نے ایک چھوٹا سا اسٹیل کا ٹکڑا ایک سرے میں ٹھونس دیا تھا۔ پھر اُس نے بلیڈ کو اچھی تیز دھار دے دی تھی۔ وہ چھوٹی لکڑی کی نُوکوں پر مزاحیہ چہرے تراش سکتا تھا اور ایلی ہمیشہ بے چین رہتی کہ وہ اگلا کیا بنائے گا۔ اس نے اس کی نقل کرنے کی کوشش کی، مگر ایسا لگتا تھا کہ وہ جلدی کچھ دلچسپ نہیں بنا پائے گی۔ پھر بھی کوشش کرنا مزے کی بات تھی، لہٰذا وہ اپنے بیڈروم کے دراز سے چھری نکالی اور باہر جا نکلی۔

ان کے پرانے پتھریلے فارم ہاؤس کے سامنے بڑا میپل کا درخت اس کی طرف اشارہ کر رہا تھا۔ اس کی نیچے جھکی شاخیں بیٹھنے کے لیے ایک بہترین جگہ معلوم ہو رہی تھیں اور وہ دوبارہ اس چھری کو آزمانے کے لیے بالکل مناسب لگتی تھیں۔ ایلی نے چند بڑی ٹہنیاں چنیں اور پھر سیدھی ٹھنڈی چھاؤں میں خود کو اوپر اٹھا لیا۔ جب وہ ٹھیک سے بیٹھ گئی تو اس نے اپنی لکڑی کے ٹکڑوں کو کاٹنا اور چھیلنا شروع کر دیا۔ وہ ابھی تک آنکھیں اور ناک تراش نہیں پاتی تھی، مگر وہ نشانات تراشنے اور چھال کے چھوٹے ٹکڑے ہٹانے میں مزہ محسوس کرتی تھی۔ یہ دوپہر کی خاموشی میں مشغول رہنے کے لیے ایک پرسکون کام تھا۔ وہ خوش تھی کہ یہ درخت ان کے صحن میں ہے، اور وہ خوش تھی کہ پال نے اسے وہ تراشنے والی چھری دی تھی۔

کافی دیر بعد، وہ شاخ جس پر ایلی بیٹھ رہی تھی سخت اور کھردری محسوس ہونے لگی، اور وہ ٹہنیاں جنہیں وہ تراش رہی تھی تقریباً ختم ہو چکی تھیں۔ “مجھے جانا چاہیے اور دیکھنا چاہیے کہ لڑکے کیا کر رہے ہیں،” اُس نے سوچا۔ وہ سب سے نیچی شاخ کی طرف منتقل ہوئی اور ہمیشہ کی طرح نیچے چھلانگ لگانے کے لیے تیار بیٹھی۔

وہ رک گئی اور اپنے ہاتھ میں رکھی چھری کو دیکھنے لگی۔ “کہیں سے بھی چھری پکڑے ہوئے چھلانگ مت لگانا!” ماں کی آواز اس کی یاد داشت میں گونجی۔ “یہ بہت خطرناک کام ہے۔ تم بہت بری طرح کاٹ سکتے ہو۔” ایلی نے اس بارے میں تھوڑی دیر سوچا۔

“ہاں، مجھے معلوم ہے کہ شاید یہ سچ ہے،” اُس نے خود سے کہا۔ “مگر میرے خیال میں اگر میں بہت محتاط رہوں تو میں چھلانگ لگا دوں گی اور سب ٹھیک ہو جائے گا،” اُس نے دلیل دی۔

اس نے اپنے دائیں ہاتھ میں چھری مضبوطی سے پکڑی، پھر تیزی سے زمین تک چھلانگ لگا دی۔ جیسے ہی وہ اتری، اس کا ٹخنا مڑ گیا اور زمین سے پھسل گیا۔ وہ بُری طرح اپنے بائیں پیر پر گِری۔ اور، افسوس! وہ چھوٹی سی چھری اس کے بائیں کلائی میں چُمٹ گئی جب وہ اپنا توازن برقرار رکھنے کی کوشش کر رہی تھی۔ اُس نے فوراً اسے باہر نکالا اور تیز دھڑکن کے ساتھ دیکھا کہ خون اُبھرتا ہے، گہرا اور گرم۔ یہ ایک چھوٹا سا کٹ تھا، تقریباً ایک چوتھائی انچ لمبا، مگر کافی گہرا داخل ہوا تھا۔

اب اسے کیا کرنا چاہیے تھا؟ ہاں، اس میں کوئی شک نہیں تھا کہ اس کی ماں بالآخر صحیح تھیں! اُس کے دل میں معلوم تھا کہ ٹھیک کام یہ ہوگا کہ وہ فوراً اپنی ماں کے پاس جائے اور بتائے جو اس نے کیا ہے۔ مگر وہ شرمندگی اور گناہ کے احساس سے بھری ہوئی تھی۔ وہ جانتی تھی کہ چھری پکڑے ہوئے چھلانگ لگانا غلط تھا، پھر بھی اس نے ایسا کر دیا تھا۔ شرمندگی سے اس نے فوراً اپنے انگوٹھے کو زخم پر دبا دیا اور گھر میں داخل ہو گئی۔ خون جلدی بند ہو گیا، اور ایک چھوٹا بینڈیج لگا کر اس نے خاموشی سے اپنی چھری رکھ دی اور ایک کتاب ڈھونڈ لی۔ اس نے اپنی ماما کو اس بارے میں کبھی نہیں بتایا جب تک کہ کئی سال گزر گئے اور وہ بالغ عورت نہ بن گئی۔

آج، جب وہ اس داغ کو دیکھتی ہے جو اب بھی 40 سال پہلے کے وقت سے نظر آتا ہے، وہ سوچتی ہے کہ خدا نے اس کی حفاظت کیوں کی۔ وہ بہت بےوقوف بچی تھی کہ فوراً اپنی ماں کے پاس جا کر اقرار نہ کیا کہ اس نے کیا کیا۔ وہ گندی، تھوڑی سی زنگ آلود چھری کے کٹنے سے شدید انفیکشن کا شکار ہو سکتی تھی۔ حالانکہ اس نے بےوقوفانہ عمل کیا، وہ شکرگزار ہے کہ خدا نے اس کی حفاظت کی، مگر وہ اب بھی چاہتی ہے کہ وہ اپنی نافرمانی ماں کے سامنے اقرار کر دیتی۔

اپنے والدین سے کچھ بھی چھپانا کبھی عقل مندی نہیں ہے۔ انہیں وہ غلط باتیں جاننا ضروری ہیں جو تم کرتے ہو، چاہے تم کتنا بھی شرمندہ یا خجیلہ محسوس کرو۔ والدین کو اپنے بچوں کے بارے میں تمام باتیں جاننے کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔ یہ خدا کا منصوبہ ہے کہ باپ اور ماں اپنے بچوں کے لیے موجود رہیں، جب تم زخمی ہو جاتے ہو تو تمہاری مدد کریں، اور تمہارا رہنمائی اور تعلیم کریں تاکہ تم اچھے، فرمان بردار بچے بننا سیکھ سکو۔ خدا کا طریقہ ہمیشہ بہترین ہوتا ہے۔

The year was around 60 AD. The Apostle Paul had been apprehended and almost killed in the Temple at Jerusalem by a mob of angry Jews.

A few days later, he had been whisked off to the Roman Procurator Felix because of danger from a group of Jewish plotters. Felix had heard his case and though there was no evidence to convict Paul, Felix had kept him in prison for the next two years until the new Procurator, Festus, took his place.

King Herod Agrippa II came to visit Festus and the two of them listened to Paul speak. During the hearing Paul …reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, [until finally] Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee –Acts 24:25. Then towards the end of Paul’s oration …Festus said with a loud voice, Paul, thou art beside thyself; much learning doth make thee mad –Acts 26:24.

Festus was not speaking of scientific knowledge, but of the fact that Paul was well-studied. Worse yet, Paul was making the governor uncomfortable with his sinful life and his reasoning made clear that the only solution for both Festus and Agrippa was to follow the Scriptures of the Hebrews.

Paul was well educated. He made clear in his letters and sermons, quoting not only from the Jewish Bible, but also from a variety of Greek and Cretan philosophers and poets.

In more modern times, it seems as though science is not a friend to faith. Many scientists claim that the idea of an intelligent designer of the Universe is ludicrous. Further, many of them would say that those who believe such things are the next thing to savages.

It certainly turns many Christians away from science entirely. They do not see something so antagonistic to the fundamental Christian faith as being useful.

I can understand this point of view, but I think that we should not give up learning simply because some of those who claim to be so knowledgeable are, in actuality, quite foolish.

Creation

When I think about the subject of science, I often begin with the subject of creation. This is the beginning of everything and is the first place where “science” and the Bible first come into conflict.

Science is simply unable to accept that there could have been a Creator God who set in motion everything that we see.

There are many books delving into the subject of intelligent design and seeing God’s fingerprints throughout creation. It takes a lot more faith to believe that the universe happened by chance, than to believe in a Creator.

The Bible makes it clear that God was not only present at the time of Creation, but it was also He who began it (John 1:1-3). Paul says For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse –Romans 1:20.

People should be able to discern that there is a Creator God involved in our world and the universe from the time of Creation. They should be able to understand a few other things about Him as well. Perhaps most important for our discussion here, we can tell by looking at creation that God is an orderly God and that He created the world to function with a specific structure and laws that govern it.

This is one of the big differences between the Creation account found in Genesis and the myths of creation found in other cultures of the time. The Bible makes it clear that God intentionally created the world, that He did so in an orderly fashion, and that He made certain that every part of it meshed with all the other parts. There is no magic or mystical thinking in the Genesis account.

The Laws of the Universe Still Stand

There are many people who believe that they can alter the way that the universe functions, that they can behave in immoral ways and not suffer the rewards of sin, and that they can do foolish things and not suffer the consequences of their behavior.

The Prophet Jeremiah tells us that there are laws which are in place that will not cease to function. Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever –Jeremiah 31:35-36.

There is a whole set of laws that governs the way that the earth rotates on its axis and orbits the sun. Everything from the speed of light to the way that gravity pulls things towards large bodies of mass was instituted at the time of Creation—…all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation –2 Peter 3:4.

Since those laws continue and do not fluctuate, we are able to understand them—at least in part. This is what science is—the study of the natural world that we see and an attempt to comprehend the ways in which it works. God created our world in such a way that if you do an experiment the same way every time, you will get the same results every time.

Science Will Never Understand Everything

The Prophet Isaiah says, For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts –Isaiah 55:8-9.

Even the smartest quantum physicists will admit that they don’t understand everything. In fact, the number of questions that they have is greater than the whole storehouse of knowledge that has been accumulated.

Most of us will have far less understanding of the universe than that. We won’t understand all the details of how the atom functions. We won’t be able to do the calculus necessary to put a satellite into orbit. That’s all right. The important thing is that we learn what we can in order to understand what an amazing and orderly God we serve.

Presuppositions are a Problem

The biggest problem that we see in science is not the science itself, rather it is the biases of the people performing the science. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God… –Psalm 14:1. By this definition, many scientists are fools.

I don’t say this lightly. Atheists observe the universe and since they believe that there cannot be a God, they must then explain how it exists without the presence of an actual Creator. This is the heart of foolishness.

When they come to gaps in their knowledge, they are silent and yet the Christian can explain them in a few simple words. As I said before, when we look at the complexity of the universe, from the tiniest things to the largest galaxies, we can see the hands of God at work.

When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained; What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him? –Psalm 8:3-4. When we think about the world around us, when we read what scientists write, it is crucial that we come to it with a knowledge that God is behind all of this. For in him we live, and move, and have our being… – Acts 17:28, and nothing that science can discern will change that.

Science should be like a detective, uncovering God’s fingerprints on the universe, not someone bound and determined to discredit His very real presence.

Many Scientists Believe in God

Looking into the past, many scientists were men who believed in the God of the Bible. Isaac Newton, Francis Bacon, Nicholas Copernicus and many others believed in the Bible and were forthright in their expression of this faith to others.

In more modern days, there are many men and women of science who believe in the God of the Bible. Just because one is working in science doesn’t mean that they are unable to have a life of faith.

Many people have co-opted scientific discoveries to push messages that are against Christian belief and teaching.

We need to remember that when there is a set of facts, there are usually different explanations that can account for their presence. Creation and evolution examine the same facts of nature, yet from a different perspective or bias, thus they end up with vastly different conclusions. Perhaps it is a little like a Sherlock Holmes story, where Dr. Watson routinely takes the facts and gives an inaccurate explanation of them, while the detective takes the same information and gives the right explanation.

Science and Medicine

It is not against Scripture to research how things work in our universe, as long as we do so within a Biblical framework and understanding that there is a Creator God who is ordering it all.

Modern medicine is an application of many various fields, including anatomy, microanatomy, genetics, and biochemistry. The point, in this case, is to observe the human body the best that we can and then to fix the things that go wrong with it. Doctors can be scientists, but most of them are simply applying knowledge which has been passed down to them through their training.

Observation is where things start. Let’s consider diabetes as an example. Aretaeus of Cappadocia in the second century AD was the first person to give a complete description of diabetes and actually gave the disease the name diabetes. The problem was that while he was able to diagnose people with this illness, he had no treatment to help his patients. Observation had only taken him so far.

Over time, other work was done that demonstrated that the problem was an issue in the pancreas and that something was specifically wrong with the islet cells. Even into the early 1900s, there was no cure for Diabetes Mellitus and the only solution that doctors had to offer was an extremely low glycemic diet with severe calorie limits—attempting to keep patients at 500 or 600 calories a day. As can be imagined, this wasn’t an ideal treatment.

It wasn’t until the 1920s that a couple of researchers in Canada discovered a way to extract insulin from dogs and administered it to a 14-year-old who was dying of diabetes. The extract saved his life and began a new era for people with diabetes.

This is the way that things work. We begin by observing a disease and various medications that seem to be effective for it, then over time and through meticulous testing we can assess what treatments are most effective for that illness.

Studies in which half of the participants with a disease are given a medication or treatment and half are given a placebo (a pill without medical efficacy) are still the most effective way of telling whether something really works.

Why Treatments Need to be Studied

There is a real tendency to believe that the things that you have been taught are effective. We know that George Washington died of pneumonia. His doctors probably damaged his chances of recovery by bleeding him four times for a total of close to 40 percent of his blood volume. They probably would have bled him a fifth time, but he wasn’t thought to be strong enough to survive the procedure.

Doctors bled patients because they believed that there were toxic build ups in the blood stream that had to be let out. Most of the people who died after bloodletting would probably have died anyway, but bleeding people who are really sick certainly doesn’t help them recover.

Maybe the doctors simply wanted to be doing something. Patients expected bloodletting and so they met those expectations, even though it harmed the patients.

Experience is what lets you make the same mistakes with a lot more confidence.

What Makes a Good Study

Good studies—have plenty of patients in them, have a control group (that either receives an inactive pill called a placebo, or the current best treatment for that disease), and have the test group getting the new treatment. It is also important for the control group and the test group to be matched as closely as possible. Finally, the size of the groups in the study is vital to the conclusions of the study. If there are only ten or twenty patients in the study, it is not a large enough group to really sort out if something works or doesn’t.

For many diseases there is something called a placebo effect. This placebo effect is when people get better from an illness even though they are not receiving something that should be effective at treating the malady. Interestingly, in studies, many people get side effects from the inert pills. If 20 percent of the people getting the placebo get better and 45 percent of the people getting the treatment get better, that would indicate that the treatment is effective. If the difference is minimal—say 20 percent of the placebo group and 23 percent of the treatment group improve—then the treatment isn’t effective.

Problems

The biggest problem with many treatments is that they simply aren’t studied. Vitamin supplements and herbal compounds may work, but many of them have never actually been studied in a trial comparing them with a control group. Most of the information is anecdotal. The fact that someone’s grandmother or uncle benefited from something is possibly an indication that it is effective, but it doesn’t tell us how effective this treatment is or what dosage level is ideal.

Another issue is when studies simply don’t have enough participants to really give accurate information. Many studies only include ten or twenty patients. That is simply not enough to identify how well a treatment works or what side effects can be expected. For a drug to be approved by the FDA, it will typically have been studied on between 1,000 to 3,000 patients with the disease.

A final issue with studies is when they show that a medication is effective, but the effect isn’t clinically significant. As an example, a new injectable medication for dementia (aducanumab) was recently approved by the FDA. It is very expensive, and the benefit seemed to be small. Patients who were on it got an average of 1.5 more test questions right on an 85-question mental status questionnaire after 18 months compared to the control group.

One can rightly question if the benefits shown by this medication are worth the 50,000 dollar-per-year cost. More than that, how much of a meaningful improvement in someone’s everyday activities would come from using such a medicine? It seems unlikely that it would make very much of a difference.

It is unfortunate, but drug companies will always try to make it seem like their medicine is the best, even if the studies do not show significant benefit over existing, cheaper options.

Conclusion

Christians are faced with a world which does not love them or their beliefs. Many would try to use science as a way to bludgeon them into giving up their faith. I hope that does not lead us to give up on the scientific method or to give up attempting to understand the laws behind the universe that God created.

The scientific method is valid, even if many of the people who use it are atheists or agnostics. If a treatment works, it should be observable, testable, and repeatable.

Even as we approach it, we have a basic understanding of the universe that atheists don’t have. Knowing that there is a Creator God who loves us makes a major difference as we interpret the results of all the different observations that are being made in the fields of medicine and other places.

Those who do not know God are bound to be ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth –2 Timothy 3:7. On the other hand, if we begin with a Biblical understanding, we can use science as a tool to help us to understand the creation that He has placed around us.

Ilikuwa mwaka karibu wa 60 BK. Mtume Paulo alikuwa ameshikiliwa na karibu kuuawa katika Hekalu huko Yerusalemu na umati wa Wayahudi wenye hasira.

Wiki chache baadaye, alichukuliwa kwa hifadhi kwa Procurator wa Kirumi Felix kwa sababu ya hatari kutoka kwa kundi la Wayahudi walioshingwa. Felix alisikiliza kesi yake na ingawa hakukuwa na ushahidi wa kumhukumu Paulo, Felix alimweka gerezani kwa miaka miwili ijayo hadi Procurator mpya, Festus, apate nafasi yake.

Mfalme Herode Agrippa II alikuja kumuona Festus na wao wawili walimsikiliza Paulo akiongea. Wakati wa kusikilizwa Paulo …alikuwa akijadili haki, kujiwekea mipaka, na hukumu ijayo, [hadi hatimaye] Felix akatetemeka, akajibu, Nenda, kwa sasa; nitakapopata wakati mzuri, nitakuita—Matendo 24:25. Kisha mwishoni mwa hotuba ya Paulo …Festus akasema kwa sauti kubwa, Paulo, wewe umepitiliza akili; maarifa mengi hukufanya uwe wazimu—Matendo 26:24.

Festus hakuzungumzia maarifa ya kisayansi, bali ukweli kwamba Paulo alikuwa amesoma kwa kina. Jambo baya zaidi, Paulo alikuwa akimfanya gavana ajihisi vibaya kwa maisha yake ya dhambi na hoja zake zilionyesha wazi kwamba suluhisho pekee kwa Festus na Agrippa ni kufuata Maandiko ya Waebrania.

Paulo alikuwa ameelimika vizuri. Alionyesha wazi kwenye barua na mahubiri zake, akinukuu si tu kutoka kwenye Biblia ya Wayahudi, bali pia kutoka kwa wanafalsafa na washairi wa Kigiriki na wa Krete.

Katika nyakati za kisasa, kunaonekana kwamba sayansi si rafiki wa imani. Wanasayansi wengi huhoji kuwa wazo la Mbunifu mwenye akili wa Ulimwengu ni uchekeshaji. Zaidi ya hayo, wengi wao wangesema kuwa wale wanaoamini mambo kama hayo ni karibu wanyama wa porini.

Hakika inatia wale Wakristo wengi mbali kabisa na sayansi. Hawaoni kitu kinachopinga imani ya Kikristo kwa msingi kuwa ni muhimu.

Naelewa mtazamo huu, lakini nadhani hatupaswi kuacha kujifunza kwa sababu baadhi ya wale wanaodai kuwa na maarifa mengi ni, kwa kweli, wajinga.

Uumbaji

Ninapofikiria kuhusu somo la sayansi, mara nyingi ninaanza na somo la uumbaji. Hii ni mwanzo wa kila kitu na ni mahali pa kwanza ambapo “sayansi” na Biblia zinaanza kupingana.

Sayansi haiwezi kukubali kwamba kumekuwa na Mungu Muumba ambaye aliweka kila kitu tunachokiwona kuanza kusogea.

Kuna vitabu vingi vinavyochambua somo la muundo wa busara na kuona vidole vya Mungu katika uumbaji wote. Inahitaji imani zaidi kuamini kwamba ulimwengu ulitokea kwa bahati, kuliko kuamini Muumba.

Biblia inaonyesha wazi kuwa Mungu hakukuwa tu mahali wakati wa Uumbaji, bali pia yeye ndiye alianza yote (Yohana 1:1-3). Paulo anasema Kwa maana matendo yasiyoonekana ya yeye tangu uumbaji wa dunia yanavyoonekana wazi, ikitambuliwa kwa vitu vilivyotengenezwa, hata nguvu zake za milele na ubinadamu wake; ili wasiwe na uzinzi wa kusamehewa—Warumi 1:20.

Watu wanapaswa kuwa na uwezo wa kugundua kwamba kuna Mungu Muumba aliyehusika katika ulimwengu wetu na ulimwengu tangu kipindi cha Uumbaji. Wanapaswa pia kuelewa mambo mengine machache kumhusu. Labda muhimu zaidi kwa mjadala wetu hapa, tunaweza kusema kwa kuangalia uumbaji kwamba Mungu ni Mwingi wa utaratibu na kwamba aliunda dunia ili ifanye kazi kwa muundo maalum na sheria zinazoisawiri.

Hii ni moja ya tofauti kubwa kati ya ukurasa wa Uumbaji ulio katika Mwanzo na hadithi za uumbaji za tamaduni nyingine za wakati huo. Biblia inaweka wazi kwamba Mungu kwa makusudi aliunda dunia, kwamba alifanya hivyo kwa mpangilio, na kwamba alihakikisha kila sehemu yake ilifananishwa na sehemu nyingine zote. Hakuna uchawi au fikra za kifahamu katika ukurasa wa Mwanzo.

Sheria za Ulimwengu Bado Zinatumika

Kuna watu wengi wanaoamini wanaweza kubadilisha jinsi ulimwengu unavyofanya kazi, kwamba wanaweza kuishi kwa njia za uovu na wasiathiriwe na malipo ya dhambi, na kwamba wanaweza kufanya mambo ya wazembe na wasiadhiwe na matokeo ya tabia yao.

Mnabii Yeremia anatueleza kuwa kuna sheria zilizo katika nafasi ambazo hazitasitishwa kufanya kazi. Bwana anasema, yeye ambaye humweka jua kuwa nuru mchana, na taratibu za mwezi na nyota kuwa nuru usiku, ndiye anayegawanya bahari wakati mawimbi yake yanaporomoka; Bwana wa majeshi ndio jina lake: Ikiwa taratibu hizo zitatoweka mbele zangu, asema BWANA, kisha taifa la Israeli litakasimama pia kutokuwa taifa mbele zangu milele—Yeremia 31:35-36.

Kuna seti nzima ya sheria zinazosimamia jinsi dunia inavyozunguka kwenye mhimili wake na kuzunguka jua. Kila kitu kutoka kwa kasi ya mwanga hadi jinsi uzito (graviti) unavyovuta vitu kuelekea miundo mikubwa ya wingi uliwekwa wakati wa Uumbaji—…mambo yote yanaendelea kama yalivyokuwa tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji—2 Petro 3:4.

Kama sheria hizo zinaendelea na hazibadiliki, tunaweza kuzifahamu—angalau kwa sehemu. Hili ndilo sayansi—masomo ya ulimwengu wa asili tunaouona na jaribio la kuelewa jinsi inavyofanya kazi. Mungu aliunda ulimwengu wetu kwa njia kwamba ukifanya jaribio kwa njia ile ile kila mara, utapata matokeo sawa kila mara.

Sayansi Haitaelewa Kila Kitu Milele

Mnabii Isaya anasema, Kwa maana mawazo yangu si mawazo yenu, wala njia zenu si njia zangu, asema BWANA. Kama mbingu zilivyo juu kuliko nchi, ndivyo njia zangu zilivyo juu kuliko njia zenu, na mawazo yangu juu kuliko mawazo yenu—Isaya 55:8-9.

Hata watafiti wa ioni (quantum) werevu watakubali kwamba hawaelewi kila kitu. Kwa kweli, idadi ya maswali wanayo ni kubwa kuliko hazina yote ya maarifa ambayo imekusanywa.

Wengi wetu tutajua kidogo sana kuhusu ulimwengu kulinganisha na hao. Hatutaelewa maelezo yote ya jinsi atomu inavyofanya kazi. Hatutaweza kufanya hesabu za juu zinazohitajika kuweka satelaiti kwenye mviringo. Hilo ni sawa. Muhimu ni kwamba tujifunze tunachoweza ili kuelewa ni Mungu jinsi gani wa kustaajabisha na aliye na utaratibu anayetumika.

Dharura za Mwanzo ni Tatizo

Tatizo kubwa tunaloliona katika sayansi si sayansi yenyewe, bali ni upendeleo wa watu wanaofanya sayansi. Mjinga amesema moyoni mwake, Hakuna Mungu…—Zaburi 14:1. Kwa ufafanuzi huu, wanasayansi wengi ni wajinga.

Sidhani hilo kwa urahisi. Wahubiri wa kutokuwa na Mungu (wanaokataa kuwepo kwa Mungu) watazitia ulimwengu na kwa kuwa wanaamini hakuna Mungu, lazima waeleze kisha jinsi ulimwengu unavyojitegemea bila uwepo wa Muumba halisi. Hili ndilo kiini cha ujinga.

Wakati wanakutana na mapengo katika maarifa yao, wanatamka kimya na bado Mkristo anaweza kuyaeleza kwa maneno machache. Kama nilivyosema hapo awali, tunaposoma ukuvu wa ulimwengu, kutoka kwa vitu vidogo kabisa hadi galaksi kubwa, tunaona mikono ya Mungu ikifanya kazi.

Napofikiria mbingu zako, kazi za vidole vyako, mwezi na nyota, ulizoziweka; ni nani mwanadamu, hadi umfikirie? na mwana wa mwanadamu, hadi umtembelee?—Zaburi 8:3-4. Tunapofikiria kuhusu dunia inayotuzunguka, tukisoma yale wanaosayansi wanaandika, ni muhimu kuja nayo ukiwa na maarifa kwamba Mungu yupo nyuma ya yote haya. Kwa maana katika yeye tunaishi, tunahamisha, na tunapata maisha yetu…—Matendo 17:28, na hakuna kitu ambacho sayansi inaweza kugundua kitakachobadilisha hilo.

Sayansi inapaswa kuwa kama mchunguzi, akigundua vidole vya Mungu kwenye ulimwengu, sio mtu aliyekhama na kuiwekea nia kumdhihaki uwepo wake halisi.

Wanasayansi Wengi Wanaamini Mungu

Ukirudia nyuma, wanasayansi wengi walikuwa wanaume walioamini Mungu wa Biblia. Isaac Newton, Francis Bacon, Nicholas Copernicus na wengine wengi waliamini Biblia na walikuwa wazi katika kuonyesha imani yao kwa wengine.

Katika siku za kisasa, kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi wa sayansi wanaoamini Mungu wa Biblia. Kwamba mtu anafanya kazi katika sayansi hakumaanishi hawezi kuwa na maisha ya imani.

Watu wengi wameibadilisha uvumbuzi wa kisayansi kutetea ujumbe unaopingana na imani na mafundisho ya Kikristo.

Tunapaswa kukumbuka kwamba pale kuna seti ya ukweli, kwa kawaida kuna maelezo tofauti yanayoweza kuelezea uwepo wao. Uumbaji na mabadiliko hupitia ukweli ule ule wa asili, lakini kutoka mtazamo tofauti au upendeleo, hivyo wanakamilisha kwa hitimisho tofauti kabisa. Labda ni kama hadithi ya Sherlock Holmes, ambapo Dk. Watson mara kwa mara huchukua ukweli na kutoa maelezo yasiyo sahihi, wakati mchunguzi anachukua taarifa ile ile na kutoa maelezo sahihi.

Sayansi na Tiba

Sio kinyume na Maandiko kuchunguza jinsi vitu vinavyofanya kazi katika ulimwengu wetu, mradi tu tufanye ndani ya muktadha wa Biblia na tuelewe kuwa kuna Mungu Muumba anayeyafanya yote.

Tiba ya kisasa ni matumizi ya nyanja mbalimbali, ikiwa ni pamoja na anatomia, microanatomia, jenetiki, na biokemia. Madhumuni, katika kesi hii, ni kuchunguza mwili wa binadamu kwa uwezo wetu wote na kisha kurekebisha yale yanayokosekana. Madaktari wanaweza kuwa wanasayansi, lakini wengi wao wanaweza tu kuvitumia maarifa yaliyopitishwa kwao kupitia mafunzo yao.

Uchunguzi ndiko kunakoanza mambo. Hebu tuchukulie kisukari kama mfano. Aretaeus wa Kappadokia katika karne ya pili BK alikuwa mtu wa kwanza kutoa maelezo kamili ya kisukari na kwa kweli alimpa ugonjwa huo jina diabetes. Tatizo lilikuwa kwamba ingawa aliweza kutambua watu wenye ugonjwa huu, hakuwa na tiba za kuwasaidia wagonjwa wake. Utafiti ulikuwa umemfikisha hadi pale tu.

Kwa muda, kazi nyingine ilifanywa iliyoonyesha kuwa tatizo lilikuwa katika kongosho na kwamba kitu kilikuwa si sawa hasa na seli za islet. Hata mwanzoni mwa miaka ya 1900, hakukuwa na tiba ya Kisukari na suluhisho pekee madaktari walionao ilikuwa mlo wa glycemic chini sana na vikwazo vikali vya kalori—wakijaribu kuweka wagonjwa kwa kalori 500 au 600 kwa siku. Kama inavyoweza kufikiriwa, hii haikuwa tiba nzuri.

Hakuwa hadi miaka ya 1920 timu ya watafiti Canada walipogundua njia ya kutoa insulin kutoka kwa mbwa na kuiwapatia mvulana wa miaka 14 aliyekuwa karibu kufa kutokana na kisukari. Mchanganyiko huo ulimokoa maisha yake na kuanza enzi mpya kwa watu wenye kisukari.

Hivi ndivyo mambo yanavyofanya kazi. Tunaanza kwa kuchunguza ugonjwa na dawa mbalimbali zinazofikiriwa kuwa na ufanisi, kisha kwa muda na kupitia upimaji makini tunaweza kutathmini ni tiba gani ndio yenye ufanisi zaidi kwa ugonjwa huo.

Masomo ambayo nusu ya washiriki wenye ugonjwa wanapewa dawa au tiba na nusu wanapewa placebo (kidonge kisicho na ufanisi wa kiafya) bado ndiyo njia bora zaidi ya kusema kama kitu kweli kinafanya kazi.

Kwanini Matibabu Yanapaswa Kusomwa

Kuna mwenendo wa kweli wa kuamini kuwa mambo uliyofundishwa ni ufanisi. Tunajua George Washington alikufa kwa pnemonia. Madaktari wake pengine waliharibu nafasi zake za kupona kwa kumfanya damu mara nne kwa jumla karibu asilimia 40 ya wingi wa damu yake. Pengine wangeweza kumfanya damu mara ya tano, lakini hawakudhani alikuwa imara vya kutosha kuishi taratibu hiyo.

Madaktari walikuwa wanamfanya mtu damu kwa sababu waliamini kuwa kulikuwa na uchafu unaotokana katika mzunguko wa damu uliohitaji kutolewa. Wengi wa wale waliokufa baada ya kuchomwa damu pengine wangekuwa wametoweka hata hivyo, lakini kumfanya mtu aliye mgonjwa vibaya damu sio msaada kwa kupona.

Pengine madaktari walitaka tu kufanya jambo lolote. Wagonjwa walitarajia kuchomiwa damu hivyo walipimika matarajio hayo, ingawa ilimuumiza mgonjwa.

Uzoefu ndilo linakuruhusu kufanya makosa yale yale kwa ujasiri zaidi.

Nini Hufanya Utafiti Kuwa Nzuri

Utafiti mzuri—una wagonjwa wengi ndani yake, una kikundi cha udhibiti (ambacho au hupokea kidonge chenye ufanisi wa kiafya au, au tiba bora ya sasa ya ugonjwa huo), na kikundi cha jaribio kinapata tiba mpya. Pia ni muhimu kwa kikundi cha udhibiti na kikundi cha jaribio kulinganishwa iwezekanavyo. Mwisho, ukubwa wa makundi katika utafiti ni muhimu kwa hitimisho za utafiti. Ikiwa kuna wagonjwa kumi au ishirini tu, haitoshi ili kutambua kama kitu kinafanya kazi au la.

Kwa magonjwa mengi kuna kitu kinachoitwa athari ya placebo. Athari ya placebo ni pale watu wanapona kutokana na ugonjwa ingawa hawapati kitu kinachotakiwa kuwa na ufanisi kwa kutibu ugonjwa huo. Kwa kushangaza, katika tafiti, watu wengi hupata madhara kutokana na vidonge visivyo na kazi. Kama asilimia 20 ya watu wanaopokea placebo wanaponya na asilimia 45 ya wale wanaopokea tiba wanaponya, hilo litaonyesha kuwa tiba ina ufanisi. Ikiwa tofauti ni ndogo—sema asilimia 20 ya kikundi cha placebo na asilimia 23 ya kikundi cha tiba wanapata nafuu—basi tiba haiko na ufanisi.

Matatizo

Tatizo kubwa na matibabu mengi ni kwamba hayajasomewa kabisa. Virutubisho vya vitamini na misombo ya mimea yanaweza kufanya kazi, lakini mengi yao hayajawahi kusomwa katika jaribio likilinganishwa na kikundi cha udhibiti. Taarifa nyingi ni za hadithi tu. Kwamba babu au mjomba wa mtu alipata nafuu kutokana na kitu fulani kunaweza kuwa dalili kuwa ni muhimu, lakini haionyeshi ni kwa kiasi gani tiba hii ni ya ufanisi au ni kipimo gani kinachofaa.

Swali nyingine ni wakati tafiti hazina washiriki wa kutosha kutoa taarifa sahihi. Tafiti nyingi zinajumuisha wagonjwa kumi au ishirini tu. Hivyo haiwezi kutambua vizuri jinsi tiba inavyofanya kazi au madhara yanayoweza kutarajiwa. Ili dawa ipitishwe na FDA, mara nyingi itakuwa imesomwa kwa wagonjwa kati ya 1,000 hadi 3,000 wenye ugonjwa huo.

Tatizo la mwisho na tafiti ni wakati zinaonyesha dawa ni yenye ufanisi, lakini athari si muhimu kiafya. Kwa mfano, dawa mpya ya sindano kwa ugonjwa wa kudorora kwa akili (aducanumab) ilikubaliwa hivi karibuni na FDA. Ni ghali sana, na faida ilionekana kuwa ndogo. Wagonjwa waliokuwa wakitumia walipata wastani wa maswali 1.5 zaidi sahihi kwenye orodha ya maswali 85 ya hali ya akili baada ya miezi 18 ikilinganishwa na kikundi cha udhibiti.

Mtu anaweza kuhoji kwa haki kama faida iliyoonyeshwa na dawa hii inastahili gharama ya dola 50,000 kwa mwaka. Zaidi ya hayo, ni kuboresha kiasi gani katika shughuli za kila siku za mtu kusingetokea kwa kutumia dawa kama hiyo? Inaonekana hawezi kuwa tofauti kubwa.

Ni huzuni, lakini kampuni za dawa zitaendelea kujaribu kuonyesha kuwa dawa yao ndiyo bora, hata kama tafiti hazionyeshi faida muhimu ikilinganishwa na chaguzi za bei nafuu zilizopo.

Hitimisho

Wakristo wanakabiliwa na dunia ambayo haiwapendi wao wala imani zao. Wengi watatumia sayansi kama njia ya kuwashinikiza waache imani yao. Natumaini hilo halitufanya tuacha mbinu ya kisayansi au kusitisha kujaribu kuelewa sheria zilizo nyuma ya ulimwengu ambazo Mungu aliunda.

Mkutano wa kisayansi ni halali, hata kama wengi wa wale wanaoutumia ni wawakataa Mungu au washakataa. Ikiwa tiba inafanya kazi, inapaswa kuonekana, kujaribiwa, na kurudiwa.

Hata tunapokaribia, tuna uelewa wa msingi wa ulimwengu ambao wanakanaji Mungu hawana. Kujua kwamba kuna Mungu Muumba anayetupenda kunafanya tofauti kubwa tunapotafsiri matokeo ya uchunguzi tofauti yanayofanywa katika nyanja za tiba na maeneo mengine.

Wale wasiomjua Mungu wamehifadhiwa kuwa daima wakijifunza, wala hawatoweza kuja kwa maarifa ya ukweli—2 Timotheo 3:7. Kwa upande mwingine, tukianza kwa uelewa wa Kibiblia, tunaweza kutumia sayansi kama zana kutusaidia kuelewa uumbaji alieweka karibu nasi.
